concepts.webLeverage: a date grid bound to live state, css transforms tearing the top leaf away, and responsive cropping of the painted plate

concepts.form: a buenos aires shop panel where every letter and scroll carries a hard drop shadow and a white highlight, so the entire painted surface appears to stand a centimeter clear of the dark lacquer behind it
concepts.lineage: fileteado porteno sign painting of Buenos Aires, its scroll and ribbon grammar, shadowed and highlighted proverb lettering
system: Palette/material: deep lacquer ground with scrollwork in scarlet, cobalt and leaf green, every form outlined dark then highlighted white on one side
Type/composition: swelling script with a hard offset shadow held inside a ribbon banner, mirrored scrolls closing both ends of the panel
Topology/navigation: everything reads as raised off the ground, so navigation lifts one element clear while the rest stay seated
Controls/state: controls are ribbon ends, the active one lifts further with a stronger shadow, and inactive ones sit flatter
Responsive/motion: scrolls mirror and repeat to fill any width, and motion is an element rising against its own shadow
concepts.spark: not one letter or leaf on the panel is flat, every single one has a shadow under it and a white highlight on top, and the whole thing floats a centimeter off the black.
concepts.webLeverage: svg mirrored scroll paths repeating responsive, shadow depth bound to interactive state, and a lift animation per element

concepts.form: a writer's blackbook page worked up in marker, interlocking wildstyle letters knitted into arrows and bars until the name is barely readable, a cleaner throw-up sketched in the corner as the fast version
concepts.lineage: New York subway wildstyle lettering, blackbook sketch practice, throw-up and piece conventions, 1975 onward
system: Palette/material: marker on cream book paper, a fill in two blending colors, a hard black outline and a second offset keyline that holds the whole mass
Type/composition: letters interlocking into one continuous mass with arrows and bars extending past the block, a small simple throw-up sketched aside
Topology/navigation: the name is the map, and moving means following an arrow extension out of one letter and into the next
Controls/state: controls are letterforms, the active one takes the second keyline and a highlight, and inactive ones stay outline only
Responsive/motion: the interlock tightens or extends its arrows with the frame, and motion is a marker stroke drawn in sequence
concepts.spark: five letters knitted so far into each other that you have to already know the name to read it, arrows shooting out past the block, and a fast simple version sketched in the corner for when there is no time.
concepts.webLeverage: svg stroke-drawn letterforms animated in sequence, responsive interlock via path morph, and focus-driven keyline state

concepts.form: a desert strip sign shop's working drawing, a towering porcelain-panel sign with a script channel letter above an animated arrow, chase-lamp sequences timed and numbered on the elevation itself
concepts.lineage: Las Vegas neon sign shop drawing practice, porcelain panel and channel-letter fabrication, chase-lamp animation sequencing
system: Palette/material: porcelain-enamel panels in cream and turquoise, exposed lamp banks, and neon in two gas colors against a night ground
Type/composition: a swelling neon script above a hard-edged arrow, with the fabrication elevation ruled and dimensioned beside the rendered face
Topology/navigation: the sign is a vertical stack of billed tenants, so moving up or down the stack moves between them
Controls/state: controls are lamp banks, the active one runs its chase sequence, and inactive banks stay dark against the porcelain
Responsive/motion: the stack sheds tenants from the bottom as height shrinks, and motion is a numbered chase running the arrow
concepts.spark: a scribbled elevation with every lamp numbered so the arrow chases in the right order, and beside it the same sign rendered at night, promising a hundred rooms and a swimming pool.
concepts.webLeverage: a timed chase-lamp animation sequence, css neon glow states, and responsive tenant stacking on the elevation

concepts.form: a state kiosk display of everyday printed goods, matchbox labels and juice cartons and tram tickets sharing one restricted ink set, each carrying a geometric mark from a central design office
concepts.lineage: Polish People's Republic kiosk goods, state design office marks, neon and packaging print under a restricted palette, 1956 to 1989
system: Palette/material: three permitted inks on gray recycled board, colors slightly off-register, paper stock varying between print runs
Type/composition: a geometric grotesque locked to a small grid, one abstract office mark per product, and no photograph anywhere
Topology/navigation: goods sit in a kiosk grid, so navigation is scanning the grid rather than descending a hierarchy
Controls/state: controls are product cells, the active one takes the third permitted ink, and out-of-stock cells print as an empty rule box
Responsive/motion: the kiosk grid reflows in whole cells only, and motion is a slight registration shift as a cell activates
concepts.spark: a matchbox, a juice carton and a tram ticket, all printed in the same three inks by the same office, each with a small abstract mark that took somebody a month and nobody was allowed to sign.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-cell responsive grid, css registration-shift animation on state, and stock state rendered as an empty rule box

concepts.form: a ration book opened flat where perforated coupon squares cover the whole spread edge to edge, serial numbers overprinted across the grid and torn stubs leaving a ragged record of everything already spent
concepts.lineage: wartime rationing books and their perforated coupon stock, official utility marks and overprinted serial numbering, 1941 to 1952
system: Palette/material: buff and sage utility stock in one ink with a serial overprint crossing the grid, thin paper with visible fiber and no coating
Type/composition: a plain grotesque locked into ruled coupon cells, perforations covering the whole spread, and a serial number overprinted diagonally across all of it
Topology/navigation: the grid is finite and visibly depleting, so navigation spends from a shrinking field rather than browsing a catalog
Controls/state: controls are coupons, spending one tears it away, and the ragged stub left behind cannot be restored
Responsive/motion: the coupon field reflows in whole rows, and motion is a perforated tear along its ruled line
concepts.spark: the whole spread is nothing but perforated squares with a serial number printed diagonally across all of them, and you can see at a glance how much of the year somebody has already used up.
concepts.webLeverage: a finite depleting coupon grid in local state, a perforated tear animation, and irreversible spent state in history

concepts.form: a state design office's product graphics, household goods carrying flat geometric marks and typographic labels from a single published standard, arranged on a shop shelf where every package obeys the same rule
concepts.lineage: GDR product graphics and the Form und Zweck design journal, state design office standards and packaging labels, 1964 to 1990
system: Palette/material: muted mustard, brick and petrol on matte board, printed in two inks with a slight fiber showing through the flat areas
Type/composition: a rational grotesque locked to a published grid, one flat geometric mark per product, and weights and codes ruled beneath
Topology/navigation: the shelf is a standard, so navigation compares products that differ only in mark and code
Controls/state: controls are product labels, the active one takes the brick accent, and discontinued lines print with a struck code
Responsive/motion: the shelf reflows in whole packages, and motion is a package turning to present its coded face
concepts.spark: a jar, a box and a bottle, all designed by the same office to the same published rule, differing only in a flat geometric mark and a code number underneath.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-package responsive shelf, comparison state across products, and a css 3d turn revealing the coded face

concepts.form: a japanese decorated truck panel at night, mirrored stainless bodywork carrying an airbrushed scene and a hand-cut name plate, every edge outlined by a dense run of individually wired marker lamps
concepts.lineage: Japanese dekotora decorated truck culture, airbrushed body panels, hand-cut name plates and marker lamp arrays
system: Palette/material: mirrored steel and lacquered body panels under amber and jade marker lamps, the whole surface read by reflected light at night
Type/composition: a hand-cut name plate at the head, an airbrushed scene owning the flank, and every structural edge traced by a lamp run
Topology/navigation: edges are the map, so navigation follows a lit outline around the form rather than moving through a page
Controls/state: controls are lamp runs, the active one sequences along its edge, and inactive runs sit dark against the steel
Responsive/motion: lamp runs add or drop lamps in whole units, and motion is a sequence chasing around an outline
concepts.spark: every single edge of the truck traced in individually wired lamps, an airbrushed scene down the flank, and a name plate somebody cut by hand, all of it only really working after dark.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg outline with a chasing lamp sequence animation, whole-unit responsive lamp runs, and lit state per edge

concepts.form: a bootleg record cut into a used chest x-ray, the ribs and shoulder blade showing straight through the groove spiral, a cigarette burn punched at the center and the title scratched into the emulsion by hand
concepts.lineage: Soviet-era bootleg records cut onto discarded medical x-ray film, hand-scratched titling and burned center holes
system: Palette/material: grayscale radiograph emulsion on flexible film, translucent so light passes through it, with the groove spiral cut across the bone
Type/composition: a hand-scratched title curved along the outer edge, the anatomy centered under the spiral, and a ragged burned hole punched through the middle
Topology/navigation: the spiral is the timeline, so navigation travels inward along the groove toward the burned center
Controls/state: controls are groove bands, the active one lights the film from behind, and played ones scuff toward opacity
Responsive/motion: the spiral redraws to any disc size over the radiograph, and motion is a rotation with light passing through the film
concepts.spark: somebody cut a record into a stranger's chest x-ray, burned the center hole with a cigarette, and scratched the song title around the edge with a nail. you can see the ribs turning under the needle.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg groove spiral over a backlit film layer, rotation animation with translucency, and per-band playback state

concepts.form: a road case buried under years of stickers, each new one slapped half over the last until the surface is a stratigraphy of partial logos, torn corners and bleached edges recording which tour came first
concepts.lineage: touring road-case and laptop sticker accretion, promotional die-cut sticker printing, layered adhesive stratigraphy
system: Palette/material: saturated die-cut vinyl over scuffed black case laminate, older layers bleached and yellowed, torn edges exposing adhesive residue
Type/composition: logos at every scale and angle, each partly covered by the next, with no element fully legible and no shared baseline anywhere
Topology/navigation: depth is chronology, so navigation peels back a layer to reach what was stuck on earlier
Controls/state: controls are stickers, the active one lifts a corner, and peeled ones leave a permanent adhesive scar
Responsive/motion: the accretion repacks to cover any surface, and motion is a corner peeling and the layer beneath showing through
concepts.spark: you cannot read a single logo on the whole case because every one is half covered by the one stuck on after it, and the ones underneath have gone yellow.
concepts.webLeverage: a responsive layered accretion with pointer-driven peel state, adhesive scar persistence, and z-order chronology

concepts.form: a rolling metal shop shutter hand-painted with the entire inventory, every product the shop sells illustrated at life size across the corrugations with the trade name arced over them in shadowed block letters
concepts.lineage: hand-painted shop shutter and roller-door sign trades, life-size product illustration, arced shadowed lettering
system: Palette/material: enamel paint over corrugated steel so every form breaks into vertical ribs, colors chosen to survive sun rather than to harmonize
Type/composition: the trade name arced across the top in shadowed block letters, products illustrated life size and ranked by what sells
Topology/navigation: the shutter is a closed inventory, so navigation moves between painted goods rather than through categories
Controls/state: controls are painted goods, the active one gains a second painted shadow, and sold-out ones are painted over
Responsive/motion: the corrugation ribs the whole surface at any width, and motion is the shutter rolling up to reveal what is behind
concepts.spark: The shop is shut, but the shutter tells you it sells hair clippers, three sizes of pot, and a rooster, all painted life size across the ribs.
concepts.webLeverage: css repeating gradient corrugation over responsive artwork, a roll-up reveal transition, and painted-over stock state

concepts.form: a vitreous enamel street plaque with the name reversed out of a deep field, a fine keyline running inside the rounded edge and the arrondissement number set small in its own corner box above the name
concepts.lineage: vitreous enamel civic street plaques, reversed-out lettering with inner keyline, district numbering conventions
system: Palette/material: deep bottle green vitreous enamel with the lettering and keyline reversed to cream, the surface glassy enough to hold a highlight
Type/composition: a narrow grotesque in caps reversed out of the field, a fine keyline inside the rounded edge, and a small numbered box at one corner
Topology/navigation: every plaque names exactly one place, so navigation moves plaque to plaque as a sequence of named locations
Controls/state: controls are plaques, the active one takes a wet enamel highlight, and passed ones dull to a matte green
Responsive/motion: the keyline follows the plate at any proportion, and motion is a highlight travelling across the glaze
concepts.spark: Deep green glass baked onto steel, the street name cut out of it in cream, and a thin line running just inside the edge that nobody needed to add and everybody did.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg keyline following responsive plate geometry, a glaze highlight animation on state, and place sequencing in the url

concepts.form: a fairground stall hung solid with prizes, identical plush animals ranked in tiers by difficulty with the hardest hanging highest, hand-lettered odds and a price board nailed across the frame above them
concepts.lineage: fairground prize stall merchandising, tiered prize ranking by difficulty and hand-lettered odds boards
system: Palette/material: saturated synthetic plush in unmixed colors hung against striped canvas, with a hand-lettered board in enamel above
Type/composition: prizes ranked in horizontal tiers with the hardest highest, and a hand-lettered price and odds board nailed across the frame
Topology/navigation: height encodes difficulty, so navigation moves up the wall toward things that are harder to get
Controls/state: controls are prize tiers, the active one swings forward on its hook, and won prizes leave a visible empty hook
Responsive/motion: tiers reflow in whole rows, and motion is a prize swinging on its hook when the tier is touched
concepts.spark: The little ones are at arm's reach and the enormous one is right at the top where everybody can see it and nobody ever gets it.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-row responsive tier grid, swing animation on hook state, and won-state leaving persistent empty hooks

concepts.form: a market stall front lined with hand-marked price cards, each a torn rectangle of board with the price scrawled in marker and the produce name beneath, wedged into the crate edge at whatever angle it landed
concepts.lineage: market stall price card practice, torn board and marker pricing, crate-wedged display conventions
system: Palette/material: torn white and dayglo board with thick black marker, wedged against crates of saturated produce under a striped awning
Type/composition: a large scrawled price dominating each card with the produce name smaller beneath, every card at a slightly different angle
Topology/navigation: the stall front is a run of cards, so navigation moves along the crate edge from price to price
Controls/state: controls are cards, the active one is straightened and re-wedged, and sold-out lines have their card turned face down
Responsive/motion: cards rewedge along the crate edge at any width, and motion is a card being pulled and pressed back in
concepts.spark: Every price is written twice the size it needs to be, on a piece of board somebody tore rather than cut, wedged in at an angle nobody straightened.
concepts.webLeverage: responsive card wedging along an edge with per-card angle state, and a pull-and-press transition on stock change

concepts.form: a tray of cast pewter pilgrim badges, each a flat openwork figure with sewing loops at its corners, the same shrine motif repeated in dozens of slightly different casts worn smooth in different places
concepts.lineage: medieval pewter pilgrim badge casting, openwork figure design with sewing loops and shrine motif repetition
system: Palette/material: dull cast pewter against dark felt, each badge flat and pierced so the backing shows through the openwork
Type/composition: a shrine motif repeated across the tray with small cast lettering around the rim, and sewing loops at every corner
Topology/navigation: the tray is a set of near-identical objects, so navigation compares casts rather than moving between subjects
Controls/state: controls are badges, the active one lifts from the felt, and heavily worn ones lose the sharpness of their motif
Responsive/motion: the tray reflows in whole badges, and motion is a badge lifting and turning to show its pierced back
concepts.spark: Thirty castings of the same little figure, and each one has worn smooth in a different place depending on which part its owner kept touching.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg openwork mask over responsive backing, wear state per cast, and a lift-and-turn animation

concepts.form: a travel document surface pairing a segmented boarding pass with a live gate board, the pass carrying a scannable block and a sequence number while the board reranks flights by departure and reflows a changed gate in place
concepts.lineage: contemporary airline boarding pass and departure board information design, segmented passes and live gate reflow
system: Palette/material: high-contrast neutral panels with one alert color reserved for changes, and a monospaced scannable block as the only texture
Type/composition: the pass divided into labeled segments with tabular figures, and the board ranking flights in a fixed column grid
Topology/navigation: departure time orders everything, so navigation is watching a ranking rather than searching a list
Controls/state: controls are flight rows, a changed gate flashes its alert color and holds it, and boarded flights drop off the board
Responsive/motion: board columns drop by priority and the pass stacks its segments, and motion is a row reranking in place
concepts.spark: The gate changes and the row does not disappear and come back somewhere else; it moves, and it stays lit until you have noticed.
concepts.webLeverage: live rerank animation preserving row identity, priority-based responsive columns, and persistent change state

concepts.form: a seat selection surface where a plan of the room is the only control, availability carried by fill, price tiers by outline, and a chosen seat locking with a countdown that shows exactly how long it is held for
concepts.lineage: ticketing and seat map information design, availability-by-fill plans with tiered outlines and held-seat countdowns
system: Palette/material: a neutral plan with seats as small shapes, fill carrying availability, outline carrying price tier, and one accent for selection
Type/composition: a room plan with a stage or screen anchored, row letters and seat numbers set tiny, and a legend ruled beside the plan
Topology/navigation: the plan is the map and the room is the hierarchy, so navigation is spatial rather than list-based
Controls/state: controls are seats, taken ones are filled and unclickable, selected ones take the accent, and held ones run a visible countdown
Responsive/motion: the plan zooms rather than reflows so spatial relationships survive, and motion is a seat filling on selection
concepts.spark: You are not picking from a list, you are pointing at a chair in a room, and once you do a clock starts telling you how long it is yours.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg plan with per-seat state, pinch and wheel zoom preserving spatial relations, and a live hold countdown

concepts.form: a lithographed yerba package where a heraldic crest and a founding date carry the whole identity, the same crest reprinted at four sizes across tin, paper bale wrapper and shipping stencil
concepts.lineage: Argentine and Paraguayan yerba mate package lithography, heraldic crest identity systems and multi-format brand reprinting
system: Palette/material: flat lithographic green, ochre and oxblood on paper and tinplate, with the same inks used on every format regardless of surface
Type/composition: a heraldic crest centred above the mark with a founding date beneath, reprinted at four sizes with detail dropping as it shrinks
Topology/navigation: the crest is the constant across formats, so navigation moves between packages that share one mark
Controls/state: controls are formats, the active one shows its crest at the correct detail level, and stencil formats reduce to solid shapes
Responsive/motion: crest detail drops in defined steps rather than scaling smoothly, and motion is a format change swapping the mark
concepts.spark: The same crest is on the tin, the paper bale, the shipping stencil and the wall of the warehouse, losing a little more detail each time until it is just three shapes.
concepts.webLeverage: a stepped-detail responsive mark that simplifies at declared sizes, per-format state, and reprint transitions

concepts.form: a fishing boat painted in banded hull colours with an eye at each side of the prow, the bands running the full length in a fixed order and the eye repainted every season whatever else is left to fade
concepts.lineage: Maltese luzzu boat painting, prow eye convention and fixed-order hull colour banding
system: Palette/material: marine enamel in yellow, red, green and blue over a tarred hull, the eye picked out in white and black with a hard outline
Type/composition: colour bands running the full hull length in an unvarying order, with the eye set forward at the prow on both sides
Topology/navigation: the hull reads as a single continuous run, so navigation travels its length rather than jumping between areas
Controls/state: controls are bands, the active one refreshes to full saturation, and neglected bands chalk and fade
Responsive/motion: bands hold their order and proportion at any length, and motion is a band being repainted along the hull
concepts.spark: The whole boat can be faded and salt-eaten, but the eye at the prow always looks freshly painted, because that is the part nobody lets go.
concepts.webLeverage: a fixed-order responsive band system along any length, per-band weathering state, and a repaint animation

concepts.form: a scrap album of chromolithographed advertising cards pasted in by their collector, cards from unrelated trades arranged for colour rather than subject, overlapping at the corners across a dark page
concepts.lineage: Victorian chromolithographed trade card advertising and the domestic scrap album, collector-arranged pasting practice
system: Palette/material: brilliant chromolithographic colour on small stiff cards pasted onto a dark album page that makes every card glow
Type/composition: cards from unrelated trades arranged by colour and shape rather than subject, overlapping at corners with no grid
Topology/navigation: the arrangement is one person's taste, so navigation follows an association nobody else would have made
Controls/state: controls are cards, the active one lifts from the page, and gaps show where a card was pulled out
Responsive/motion: cards rearrange while keeping their overlaps, and motion is a card lifting from its paste corners
concepts.spark: A soap advertisement pasted next to a thread advertisement next to a seed catalogue card, arranged entirely because they were the same shade of red.
concepts.webLeverage: a responsive overlapping arrangement with pointer-driven lift, gap state where cards were removed, and a dark page ground

concepts.form: a square of printed tissue wrapped around a single piece of fruit, a house brand lithographed at full colour on paper so thin the fruit shows through, discarded by everyone except the people who collected them
concepts.lineage: citrus fruit wrapper tissue lithography, grower house brands and single-fruit wrapping practice
system: Palette/material: full-colour lithography on tissue thin enough to see through, colours reading differently against fruit than against white
Type/composition: a centred house brand device with the grower and region ruled around it, designed to be legible however the square is crumpled
Topology/navigation: each wrapper is one grower, so navigation moves between houses that all wrapped the same fruit
Controls/state: controls are wrappers, the active one flattens out, and crumpled ones show the design distorted
Responsive/motion: the square holds its proportion while the design crops, and motion is a wrapper flattening or crumpling
concepts.spark: Full-colour printing on paper thin enough to read a newspaper through, wrapped around one orange, thrown away by everybody, and now the only record the farm ever existed.
concepts.webLeverage: a translucent responsive square with crumple distortion state, flatten animation, and ground-dependent colour rendering

concepts.form: a canal boat painted in a fixed repertoire of roses and castles, the same handful of motifs applied to cabin panel, water can and stool by every painter on the cut, varying only in the hand that made them
concepts.lineage: British narrowboat roses and castles painting, fixed motif repertoire across boat and household objects
system: Palette/material: signwriter's enamel over a dark ground in scarlet, chrome yellow and green, applied wet in one pass with no underdrawing
Type/composition: a castle scene panelled on the cabin side and roses grouped on every smaller object, always on the same dark ground
Topology/navigation: the same motifs recur across unrelated objects, so navigation moves object to object through one repertoire
Controls/state: controls are objects, the active one shows its painter's hand, and the motif set never changes between them
Responsive/motion: motifs rescale to whatever object they sit on, and motion is a rose painted in one loaded stroke
concepts.spark: Everybody painted the same roses and the same castle, on the boat, the water can and the stool, and the only thing that ever changed was whose hand did it.
concepts.webLeverage: a fixed motif repertoire rescaling across object types, per-hand style variation state, and a single-stroke paint animation

concepts.form: the interior page of a photocopied zine, one typed column of argument running down a sheet of coloured copy-shop stock under the same typing enlarged on the platen until its letters break up and the last word runs off the edge of the paper
concepts.lineage: the typed-and-photocopied fanzine interior, 1977 to 1995, from Sniffin' Glue through the Maximum Rocknroll and Factsheet Five column era and the copy-shop coloured-stock years
concepts.spark: A goldenrod sheet still warm from the copier, a single typed column running its full length, the heading enlarged until the counters have filled in and the last word is cut clean off by the edge of the paper.
system: Palette/material: colour is the sheet, never the mark. One stock per sheet: bond, goldenrod, cherry, orbit orange, solar yellow, terra green, lunar blue, gamma violet, grey pulp.
Type/composition: Letter Gothic at 16-17px on 1.7 leading, fixed 65-character measure; display is the same face in caps, platen-enlarged to 200 or 400 percent until counters fill.
Topology/navigation: one sheet is square to the frame at full size, its neighbours present only as an 8-12mm strip of their stock at the edge. Stock maps territory, never state.
Controls/state: unset is the typed cell [ ], set it overstruck with an X, chosen a hand-ink stamp out of register; rank is copier magnification, 100 percent against 74 or 64.
Responsive/motion: motion is paper feed and platen scan at a constant sheet per second, linear, never a curve or a fade. Width shows more sheet edges, never a wider column.
concepts.webLeverage: A real copy-generation filter: feTurbulence displacement, a dilate, and a discrete feComponentTransfer threshold, exposed as generations 0-3 on a data attribute and seeded from element position, over a fibre ground tiled from turbulence.

concepts.form: an acid-house rave flyer, chrome-bevel logotype over a fractal backdrop, smiley yellow punctuation, an info line promising a secret location and a phone number
concepts.lineage: UK acid house 1988-92, Fantazia and Dreamscape flyers, Hacienda print culture
system: Palette/material: smiley yellow and hot magenta on a black fractal ground, chrome-gradient silver for the headline logotype, the yellow reserved for the active call to action
Type/composition: a chrome-bevel logotype dominating the top half, venue and date stacked in tight caps along a bottom info line, everything centered on the vertical axis
Topology/navigation: one flyer face per event; the headline pulls you in, the info line at the foot holds every practical answer, the phone number is the deep link
Controls/state: the smiley is the confirm button and pressing it grins wider; secret details stay scrambled until the night unlocks them line by line
Responsive/motion: the logotype scales to width and the info line wraps last; motion is a slow fractal zoom behind static type
concepts.spark: Someone presses the flyer into your hand outside the chip shop, chrome letters flashing under the streetlight, and you memorize the phone number on the info line because the map only exists after midnight.
concepts.webLeverage: canvas fractal zoom background under css chrome-gradient text; the info line stays pinned with position sticky

concepts.form: a nineties mecha-anime crisis wall, phosphor orange and acid green type on absolute black, hazard-chevron bands framing bilingual kanji-over-caps labels, seven-segment countdowns at monumental scale
concepts.lineage: Neon Genesis Evangelion MAGI displays, Gainax screen graphics, nineties mecha-anime UI tradition
system: Palette/material: phosphor orange and acid green on absolute black ground, red reserved for condition bars, alarms invert to yellow-on-black chevrons with a red-boxed headline
Type/composition: bilingual labels stack a kanji headline over spaced roman caps, every block ruled and framed, seven-segment countdown digits set at monumental scale
Topology/navigation: hexagonal cell overlays tile the black field, leader lines run from a central schematic silhouette out to framed label blocks at the edges
Controls/state: cross-hair calipers snap to the target, signed counters tick under each reading, red condition bars fill by severity, warnings band the frame
Responsive/motion: narrow frames stack the label blocks over one countdown clock; motion is counter ticks and chevron crawl
concepts.spark: sirens drop to a hum as the lights go down; the wall floods orange, seven-segment digits taller than you count backward, hazard chevrons crawl the border while kanji headlines snap over spaced caps and a red bar creeps toward its limit
concepts.webLeverage: css text-shadow does the phosphor glow, canvas draws the rainbow contour plots, and a steps() animation ticks the seven-segment countdown digits

concepts.form: an arcade marquee row, backlit painted logotypes glowing above each cabinet, airbrushed side-art heroes down a dark aisle, attract screens cycling their promises
concepts.lineage: golden-age arcade cabinet art, Atari and Williams marquees, the airbrush illustration trade
system: Palette/material: near-black aisle ground, marquees in backlit cyan, magenta and sunset airbrush fades, phosphor white for score type, the lit marquee is the active state
Type/composition: chrome-and-bevel game logotypes painted wide on each marquee band, scores in phosphor bitmap caps, side art running full-height on the flanks
Topology/navigation: one cabinet per destination down a single dark aisle; the glowing marquee band is the signpost, the attract screen previews before you commit a coin
Controls/state: coin-in wakes a cabinet from attract loop to play, the marquee holds its glow, high-score entry takes exactly three phosphor initials
Responsive/motion: the row collapses to one lit cabinet at a time on phones; attract screens loop on idle
concepts.spark: You walk the dark aisle with a pocket of quarters, marquee glow striping the ceiling, and stop where an attract screen resets its demo just as your reflection lines up with the joystick.
concepts.webLeverage: layered box-shadow builds the backlit marquee glow; canvas attract loops pause under prefers-reduced-motion

concepts.form: a jazz-session anime title card, flat mustard, brick, teal, and cream fields sliced by hard asymmetric bars, oversized grotesk titles set tight with deliberate collisions, silhouettes in freeze-frame, print texture over cel color
concepts.lineage: Cowboy Bebop title cards and eyecatches, Sunrise print-graphic sensibility, jazz LP typography
system: Palette/material: flat mustard, brick red, teal, and cream fields over ink black, one field flooding behind the active title, print grain dusting every color
Type/composition: oversized grotesk caps set tight to deliberate collisions, episode numbering as ornament, hard asymmetric bars slicing the frame into ranked fields
Topology/navigation: each section is a card cut like a title frame; you move by hard cuts between compositions, a numbered index strip keeping the running order
Controls/state: the current item freezes as a silhouette against its flooded color field, hover slides a bar across the frame, selection stamps the number
Responsive/motion: narrow frames stack the bars horizontal with titles breaking mid-word on purpose; motion is freeze-frame cuts on a beat
concepts.spark: a brass hit lands and the frame freezes: a figure flat black against mustard, a teal bar slicing past its shoulder, the session title crashing letters together above a tiny episode number, grain settling over the color like an old print
concepts.webLeverage: css grid slices the asymmetric color bars while negative letter-spacing collides the display caps, grain screened on with blend modes

concepts.form: a silver-age comic page, ben-day dots and four-color misregistration on pulp, caption boxes and thought bubbles, action lettering carrying its own physics
concepts.lineage: silver-age four-color printing, Jack Kirby page layouts, Roy Lichtenstein's appropriation
system: Palette/material: CMYK process inks on yellowed pulp, ben-day dots mixing flesh from magenta on white, flat process-blue skies, red reserved for the action state and its lettering
Type/composition: hand-lettered caps in caption boxes and bubbles, bold-italic emphasis mid-sentence, sound effects in outlined burst letters that scale with impact
Topology/navigation: a six-panel grid read left to right; caption boxes hand off between scenes, a splash page interrupts the grid only when the story earns it
Controls/state: the active panel registers its plates cleanly while idle panels drift a half-dot off register, thought bubbles hold unsaved intent
Responsive/motion: the grid stacks to one panel per screen on phones; motion is a panel-to-panel wipe with a burst on commit
concepts.spark: You flatten the comic on the spinner rack's bottom shelf, pulp smell rising, and see the printing slipped, the hero's red sitting a half dot off his outline for the whole fight.
concepts.webLeverage: css blend modes stack simulated CMYK plates; a misregistration offset animates via transform translate

concepts.form: an action-figure blister-card wall, character art framing a vacuum-formed bubble on a pegboard of punch-hole cards, the full lineup printed across every cardback
concepts.lineage: Kenner Star Wars cardbacks, Hasbro blister packaging, toy-aisle merchandising
system: Palette/material: glossy black card under a clear PVC bubble, silver logotype rail across the top, one line-color band per wave, accent red reserved for the active peg
Type/composition: the character name in wide movie-logo caps under the bubble, the cardback lineup set as a numbered thumbnail grid, legal lines in tiny type at the foot
Topology/navigation: a pegboard grid of identical cards; the front sells one item, the cardback indexes the whole collection as your map to what is missing
Controls/state: the sealed bubble is the untouched state, lifting a card off its peg opens detail, owned items get a check on the cardback lineup while gaps stay ghosted
Responsive/motion: cards reflow to a two-up peg column on phones; motion is the card swinging off its peg hole
concepts.spark: You run a thumb along the peg hooks, cards clicking, until one bubble catches the fluorescent light, and you flip it to the cardback where the whole lineup stares out in numbered squares, three of them still missing from your shelf.
concepts.webLeverage: css grid pegboard; backdrop-filter and layered box-shadow render the raised PVC bubble, drag lifts a card off its peg

concepts.form: a supermarket cereal aisle, a planogram wall of saturated boxes with mascots aimed at child eye height, burst violators and prize call-outs up front, mazes waiting on the back panels
concepts.lineage: mid-century cereal box design, General Mills and Kellogg's mascot art, supermarket planogram craft
system: Palette/material: cereal-red and sunrise yellow on coated board, milk-white side panels carry body copy, a sunburst NEW! violator in untinted yellow marks the active item
Type/composition: fat rounded logotype arched across the box top, prize call-outs in starburst caps, condensed nutrition type ranked down the side panel
Topology/navigation: the aisle is a planogram grid of box facings, each front opens to a back panel where the mazes and fine print live
Controls/state: picking a box pulls it proud of the shelf and its mascot turns to meet your eye, the burst violator stamps NEW on whatever changed
Responsive/motion: narrow screens shrink the wall to a single-facing carousel; motion is a shelf-glide dolly down the aisle
concepts.spark: You crouch to the second shelf where the mascots aim their eyes, a toucan and a tiger grinning at kid height, and turn a box over to trace the back-panel maze while the whole wall hums with competing yellows.
concepts.webLeverage: css grid planogram with scroll-snap facings; a 3d flip transition turns each box to its back panel

concepts.form: a city-pop airbrush sleeve, chrome script logotype over a gradient sunset sky, pastel sea horizon and glass-tower skyline, palm silhouettes placed like punctuation, bilingual titles sharing the cover in balance
concepts.lineage: eighties Japanese city-pop LP artwork, Hiroshi Nagai resort paintings, Eizin Suzuki airbrush school
system: Palette/material: gradient sunset ground from peach through rose to powder blue, airbrushed aqua sea as the body field, chrome script reserved for the title mark
Type/composition: a chrome script logotype floats above the horizon while japanese and english titles share the lower band in small balanced caps
Topology/navigation: everything hangs on one horizon line; sections are stations along the shore you glide between, palms and glass towers marking the stops
Controls/state: controls are smooth airbrushed pills, hover raises a soft light flare, the active choice takes a chrome rim and a reflection in the water
Responsive/motion: the horizon holds as frames narrow, the skyline compressing before the sea does; motion is a slow parallax drift toward sunset
concepts.spark: the sky grades peach into powder blue behind a chrome script you could almost touch; a windshield flares once out on the coast road, palms stand like commas along the aqua horizon, and the evening looks airbrushed smooth enough to drive into
concepts.webLeverage: layered css gradients paint the sunset and sea, background-clip text chromes the script logotype, and scroll parallax drifts the skyline

concepts.form: a cyberpunk glyph-rain terminal, pale green half-width katakana and digits falling in columns of unequal speed, bright leading characters over fading tails, wireframe schematics surfacing through the cascade
concepts.lineage: The Matrix digital rain, Ghost in the Shell 1995 terminal sequences, cyberpunk hacker-screen tradition
system: Palette/material: pale phosphor green glyphs on black ground, leading characters burned near white, tails fading through green to charcoal, the active column held brightest
Type/composition: monospaced half-width katakana and digits in strict vertical columns of unequal speed, data locking into readable rows only where you focus
Topology/navigation: content surfaces out of the rain as wireframe panes; you tunnel between layers, the cascade always falling behind the one in focus
Controls/state: hover freezes a column to legibility, selection burns its glyphs white and holds them, idle panes dissolve back into falling texture
Responsive/motion: narrow screens thin the rain to a margin curtain beside one readable pane
concepts.spark: green glyphs sheet down the dark like rain on glass; you stare until a column slows, katakana snapping into a name you know, and a wireframe city rotates up through the cascade while the rest keeps falling behind your reflection
concepts.webLeverage: a canvas loop draws thousands of falling glyphs with per-column speed, css mix-blend-mode screening them over the wireframe svg layer

concepts.form: a pill-cornered starship wall panel, thick colored elbows turning every corner, flat pastel lilac, peach, gold, and periwinkle blocks on pure black, numeric code clusters as button labels, the frame itself the layout grid
concepts.lineage: Michael Okuda's LCARS for Star Trek: The Next Generation, okudagram screen graphics tradition
system: Palette/material: flat lilac, peach, gold, and periwinkle blocks on pure black ground, no gradients and no glow, the warmest gold saved for the active segment
Type/composition: condensed uppercase set flush inside each block, numeric code clusters as button labels, the sweeping elbow frame is the only layout grid
Topology/navigation: thick elbows sweep the frame and branch into ranked pill segments; sections are color banks you travel between, never pages that reload
Controls/state: every pill is a button, a press blinks it to a brighter tint with a short chirp cue, numeric codes reorder to show the routine now running
Responsive/motion: on narrow screens the elbow rotates to run down the left edge with pills stacking below; motion is instant color swaps, nothing left to reduce
concepts.spark: you rest a palm on the black glass, pastel pills glowing flat as paint; a fingertip tap turns a peach segment gold, a numeric cluster reshuffles beside it, and the great lilac elbow sweeps the whole wall around to the next bank of codes
concepts.webLeverage: css border-radius and grid draw the elbow frames natively, and :active state swaps flat background colors with zero transition time

concepts.form: an endurance-racing garage, Martini stripes and Gulf orange-over-blue run as portable identity systems across bodywork, number roundels and sponsor patchwork resolved into speed
concepts.lineage: Martini Racing livery, the Gulf Porsche 917, Le Mans endurance livery tradition
system: Palette/material: Gulf powder blue with a marigold stripe, or white ground running Martini's light blue, dark blue and red bands, the white number roundel as focus state
Type/composition: sponsor logotypes gridded to panel lines, race numbers in heavy grotesk digits inside roundels, the stripe system reading identity before any word does
Topology/navigation: stripes run nose to tail as the wayfinding spine; sections read as body panels, the roundel anchors each car's page and the pit board calls the lap
Controls/state: the live car carries the lit roundel, stints tick on the pit board, a sponsor panel dims when its system is cold and flares on activation
Responsive/motion: on narrow screens the stripe spine turns vertical and panels stack along it; changes streak with speed lines
concepts.spark: You stand in the garage at 3 a.m. as the 917 rolls in, powder blue and marigold under sodium light, and a mechanic wipes the roundel clean so the number reads for the night stint.
concepts.webLeverage: css linear-gradient stripe systems persist across view transitions, carrying identity between pages

concepts.form: a midcentury spaceflight status wall, a black frame of small glowing rectangular screens, each one flat color field carrying a three-letter code in white extended caps, red, amber, green, and blue reading as one calm wall of state
concepts.lineage: 2001: A Space Odyssey HAL 9000 displays, Douglas Trumbull screen graphics, Eurostile Bold Extended tradition
system: Palette/material: matte black frame as ground, each cell a single flat field of signal red, amber, green, or cool blue, white extended caps the only ink
Type/composition: bold extended caps with squared curves, one three-letter code centered per cell, the even grid of cells is the entire composition, lowercase never spoken
Topology/navigation: an even grid of labeled cells grouped by function, not hierarchy; you read the wall whole, then lean into one cell to expand it in place
Controls/state: state is color and nothing else: a cell turns amber to warn and red to fail, acknowledged cells settle back to green, touch expands the code to words
Responsive/motion: the grid reflows from wall to single column keeping cell proportions; the only motion is a measured color crossfade
concepts.spark: the cabin is silent except for air; you float before a black wall of small lit windows, each holding three white letters on its own calm color, and when one square slips from green to amber the whole room seems to lean toward it
concepts.webLeverage: css grid tiles the code cells and background-color transitions carry all state, a variable font width axis stretching the extended caps

concepts.form: a football kit wall, embroidered crests over the heart, drop-shadow number typography across the back, sponsor lockups and sleeve patch grammar, home and away colorway logic
concepts.lineage: Admiral and Umbro kit eras, national team crest heraldry, football shirt typography
system: Palette/material: home colors saturated on polyester weave, the away kit their inverse, gold embroidery thread on the crest, the captain's armband hue as active accent
Type/composition: drop-shadow numerals filling the back panel, the player name arched above in spaced caps, crest and sponsor lockup balancing the chest line
Topology/navigation: the crest is home, always over the heart; the back number identifies, the sleeve patches say which competition you are in tonight
Controls/state: switching context swaps home for away colorway with the crest untouched, a sleeve patch appears per active competition, retired numbers lock
Responsive/motion: narrow screens show the chest first and a tap spins to the number back; motion is a fabric ripple on the swap
concepts.spark: You hold the new shirt up to the light, thumb finding the raised gold thread of the crest, then turn it around to see your own name arched over a nine in drop-shadow numerals.
concepts.webLeverage: variable font weight plus svg filters build the drop-shadow numeral style; css custom properties swap the colorway

concepts.form: a used-future starship crew terminal, green and amber phosphor caps on curved crt black, hazard pictograms and stenciled equipment codes on grimy off-white panels, a workhorse ship's paperwork made screen
concepts.lineage: Alien's Nostromo and Mother screens, Ron Cobb's Semiotic Standard, used-future production design
system: Palette/material: green phosphor body text and amber warnings on curved crt black, grimy off-white panel chrome around the glass, stencil black for equipment codes
Type/composition: chunky monospaced uppercase readouts that type themselves line by line, stenciled codes and striped pictogram plates labeling every zone
Topology/navigation: one query line at a time, the screen answers in typed pages; deck plans are schematic plates you request by code rather than browse
Controls/state: commands are typed and acknowledged in caps, standby is a blinking block cursor, danger swaps the phosphor to amber under a striped hazard plate
Responsive/motion: small screens keep one column of typed lines and shrink pictogram plates to icons; motion is the character-by-character print
concepts.spark: the ready room hums with recycled air; you key a query and the curved glass answers in green capitals, one letter at a time, while an amber line blinks about pressure and a striped pictogram plate above the hatch says exactly what not to touch
concepts.webLeverage: a css steps() typewriter reveal prints each phosphor line, with border-image stripes and svg pictogram plates for the hazard chrome

concepts.form: a kaiju-era emergency broadcast graphic, brush-weight kanji title cards over roman subtitles, red and white civil-defense stripes, evacuation maps with bold arrows, newsreel monochrome cut with full-color alarm frames
concepts.lineage: Showa-era tokusatsu broadcast inserts, Godzilla-series alert graphics, Japanese civil-defense print
system: Palette/material: newsreel gray monochrome as ground, civil-defense red and white stripes framing every alert, full color reserved for the alarm frame alone
Type/composition: brush-weight kanji headlines over small spaced roman subtitles, centered with bureaucratic calm, evacuation arrows the heaviest strokes on the page
Topology/navigation: broadcast order rules the sequence: title card, map, instruction, in fixed succession; the map's bold arrows are the only wayfinding that matters
Controls/state: routine notices stay in calm gray bureaucracy, escalation adds the striped border, the true alarm cuts to full color under a held siren card
Responsive/motion: small screens crop to the headline and one arrow; motion is hard broadcast cuts and a slow stripe crawl
concepts.spark: the picture cuts from gray newsreel to a striped frame; brush-stroke kanji fill the screen over a quiet roman subtitle, a map slides in with one thick arrow pointing away from the coast, and the announcer's calm makes it worse
concepts.webLeverage: css repeating-linear-gradient draws the civil-defense stripes with an animation crawling them, filter grayscale holding the newsreel ground

concepts.form: a weekly manga page, screentone gradients standing in for every material, speed lines bending panel space, bleeds breaking the gutter for emotion, sound effects drawn as characters
concepts.lineage: weekly manga print production, Shonen Jump layouts, Letratone and IC screentone sheet craft
system: Palette/material: black ink on newsprint white only, material rendered by tone pitch, 60-line 10% dot for skin, 30% for shadow, solid black fill reserved for the decisive beat
Type/composition: dialogue in rounded type inside bubbles, sound effects hand-drawn as expressive characters, panels ranked right to left on the page grid
Topology/navigation: read right to left, top to bottom; gutters pace time, a bleed past the trim marks the emotional peak, the page turn is the cliffhanger
Controls/state: focus tightens with speed lines converging on the chosen panel, hover raises tone density one step, the active panel breaks its gutter
Responsive/motion: panels stack single-file on phones keeping right-to-left order within rows; speed lines animate on transitions
concepts.spark: You hold the phone-book weekly open on the train, newsprint graying your fingers, and hit a spread where the speed lines converge and the tone drops to solid black for one panel.
concepts.webLeverage: svg pattern fills reproduce exact tone pitches; repeating radial-gradient halftones scale without moire

concepts.form: a neo-tokyo neon night, kanji signage stacking rain-black towers in red, magenta, and cyan, taillight streaks smearing into light trails, hazard stripes and government stencils on concrete, one red accent burning at the center
concepts.lineage: Akira's Neo-Tokyo production design, Katsuhiro Otomo, cyberpunk anime cityscape tradition
system: Palette/material: rain-black ground with stacked neon kanji in magenta and cyan, wet reflections doubling every light, one scarlet accent burning for the live element
Type/composition: vertical kanji sign stacks played against horizontal stenciled roman caps, compositions built tall with the red mark always weighted at center
Topology/navigation: the page is a tower you climb; signage stacks mark the districts, hazard stripes fence off restricted sections, streets scroll sideways at ground level
Controls/state: dormant signs hold a dim tube glow, the active one snaps to full neon with a reflection beneath, warnings flicker like failing gas before they die
Responsive/motion: small screens keep one sign stack and shorten trails to glints; taillight streaks smear on scroll
concepts.spark: rain needles past the tube light; you crane up a tower of stacked kanji burning magenta over cyan, a taillight smears its red ribbon down the wet street, and somewhere above, one scarlet sign holds the whole night's center of gravity
concepts.webLeverage: scroll-linked animation smears the taillight trails while css blur and blend modes double every neon sign in wet-asphalt reflection

concepts.lineage: Persona 5 menu and battle UI, Shigenori Soejima's art direction, stylish JRPG interface tradition
system: Palette/material: flat scarlet ground with black torn-paper shapes and white knockout type, halftone gray for texture, the current choice flipped to white-on-black

Topology/navigation: menus are full-screen splashes, each choice a jagged cutout at its own angle; a silhouette owns a third of the frame and points the way onward

concepts.lineage: Dragon Quest command windows, Final Fantasy menu screens, 8-bit and 16-bit JRPG conventions
system: Palette/material: deep blue gradient panel ground under crisp double white borders, white pixel text as body ink, gold reserved for coin and item counters

Topology/navigation: windows stack in strict z-order, each choice opening a smaller bordered pane beside the last; the pointing hand always marks where you are
Controls/state: the hand cursor steps between rows with a click, a confirmed choice flashes its window, a blinking triangle in the corner promises more text
Responsive/motion: on small screens windows go full-width and stack; the only motions are letter-by-letter reveal and cursor blink

Topology/navigation: one card is one unit of meaning; the frame's fixed slots are the wayfinding, cost top-left, identity center, power bottom-right, always

concepts.form: a wax pack of baseball cards, team-color borders framing posed portraits, stat tables ruled across the card backs, a rookie flag cutting one corner
concepts.lineage: Topps 1952-89 card design, Fleer, the Upper Deck hologram era

Controls/state: doubles stack behind the front card, a flip reveals the stats, the rookie flag and a gum stain mark provenance states you cannot fake

concepts.spark: You crack the wax seal and the gum dust rises, then deal the stack card by card onto the bedspread, team borders flashing past, hunting the one rookie flag the checklist says is in this series.

concepts.form: a consumer camcorder viewfinder, REC dot and timestamp locked in monospace corners, tracking bands and tape noise fraying the frame edges while the scene plays underneath

system: Palette/material: white OSD monospace over the live scene, one blinking rec red as the sole accent, gray tracking-noise bands at the frame edges, black letterbox as ground

Topology/navigation: one full-bleed frame is the whole space; menus overlay as corner stacks and moving between views reads as tape transport, rewind and cue
Controls/state: the active item blinks like the REC dot, toggles read as OSD glyphs switching, errors arrive as tracking bands and a shaking PLEASE INSERT TAPE line
Responsive/motion: corners keep their glyphs while the frame letterboxes at narrow widths; motion is tape jog and brief static between views
concepts.spark: you press record and the red dot starts blinking over your sister's birthday, the timestamp counting in the corner, and when the tape drops out for a second the whole kitchen tears into gray bands before snapping back
concepts.webLeverage: css blend modes and an svg noise filter composite the OSD over any content, with a canvas static burst on view transitions

Controls/state: chrome toggles snap between labeled positions, sliders ride milled tracks, the running process shows as VU needles and a climbing amber ladder

concepts.spark: you thumb a chrome toggle and it lands with a click you feel in the shelf, the amber ladder climbs as the reels take up, and the aluminum is cool under your wrist while the counter rolls

concepts.spark: through camper vans and cowbells the polka dots crest the col first, a fan's painted ALLEZ sliding under his wheels, and the yellow jersey, forty seconds back, becomes a countdown the whole mountain can read
concepts.webLeverage: live gap timers stream along an svg climb profile with jerseys as draggable comparison markers on the road

concepts.form: a ligne claire adventure album page, every object drawn with the same unvarying line weight and filled with flat unshadowed color, the brussels clear-line discipline making a harbor crane as legible as a teacup
concepts.lineage: Hergé and Studios Hergé, Casterman album printing, Brussels clear-line school, Edgar P. Jacobs
system: Palette/material: flat unmodulated fills held by one even black line, daylight blue and sand ochre midtones, no gradients or cast shadows, red saved for the object the story needs
Type/composition: hand-lettered upright caps in white speech balloons, narration in yellow caption boxes, panels ranked in the album's strict four-tier waffle grid
Topology/navigation: pages read tier by tier; a wide establishing panel opens each scene, and section changes are page turns, never dissolves inside a panel
Controls/state: the active panel keeps full color while the rest of its tier rests one tone paler, selection is the same black line drawn heavier, alarm arrives as speed lines only
Responsive/motion: tiers stack one panel at a time on phones in reading order; motion is a clean cut from panel to panel with no easing flourish
concepts.spark: You flatten the album under the lamp and the moon rocket stands in checkerboard red and white, drawn with the same calm line as the professor's teacup, every rivet exactly as important as it should be.
concepts.webLeverage: svg shapes with a single stroke width scale losslessly, and css flat fills swap per state without any shading pipeline

concepts.form: an augmentation console, where black voids are inlaid with gilt filigree and every capability grows on a hexagonal tree
concepts.lineage: Deus Ex: Human Revolution art direction, Jonathan Jacques-Belletete, Renaissance-cyberpunk, 2011
concepts.spark: A hexagon lights amber at the center of a dark panel, and gilt vine-work threads outward to the augments it unlocks. Baroque filigree frames a cold readout. Gold leaf and machine oil share one surface.
system: Palette/material: Deep charcoal and near-black grounds inlaid with flat antique gold and a single amber highlight
Type/composition: A high-contrast serif for titles paired with a narrow technical sans for data, set inside filigree frames; hexagonal modules tile the working area
Topology/navigation: Move by hexagon branch, by augment tier, and by filigree-framed panel.
Controls/state: Unlock, branch, and invest; an acquired node fills from hollow gold outline to solid gilt and threads a vine to its neighbors.
Responsive/motion: The hex tree recenters and prunes outer rings on small screens; reduced-motion fills nodes solid instantly without the drawing sweep.
concepts.webLeverage: Build the augmentation tree as an SVG hex grid and animate each unlock with an SVG stroke-draw on the gilt connector paths.

concepts.form: an Afrofuturist control surface, where raised kinetic sand and warm gold form rotating rings of glyphs
concepts.lineage: Wakandan design language, Black Panther production design, Hannah Beachler and Ruth Carter, Afrofuturism, 2018
concepts.spark: Fine black sand rises into raised relief on a low table, spelling a ring of glyphs in warm gold light. A fingertip turns the ring; the sand collapses and reforms into the next command. Ochre earth meets refined gold.
system: Palette/material: Warm ochre, deep umber, and matte black grounds lit by antique gold
Type/composition: A humanist sans for interface copy beside a ring of geometric glyphs; concentric circular dials organize the field; radial hierarchy from a warm central sun.
Topology/navigation: Move by rotating glyph ring, by concentric tier, and by raised-sand region.
Controls/state: Turn, raise, and settle; a chosen glyph lifts higher in relief and warms from umber to gold as the ring locks.
Responsive/motion: Rings collapse to a single stacked dial on narrow screens; reduced-motion cross-fades relief maps with no grain animation.
concepts.webLeverage: Render the sand relief as a canvas heightfield displaced by Perlin noise, and drive glyph-ring rotation with a CSS conic-gradient dial control.

concepts.form: a taisho-era magazine cover where nihonga brushwork meets european art nouveau line, a long-limbed figure held inside a bordered panel with the title set as drawn lettering across the top
concepts.lineage: Takehisa Yumeji's covers and sheet-music designs, Japanese Taisho magazine art direction, 1912 to 1926
system: Palette/material: muted mineral rose, moss, and dusk violet over cream stock, with one deep indigo used only for outline and border rules
Type/composition: a drawn display title spans the head of the panel, small vertical annotations run the outer margin, and the figure holds the center
Topology/navigation: each view is a bordered panel with the same margin ratio, so moving is turning to the next issue rather than scrolling a surface
Controls/state: controls sit as small bordered plates in the margin, the active one takes the indigo rule, and the rest stay at cream weight
Responsive/motion: the border ratio holds and the panel crops inward, and motion is a slow paper turn with the border redrawing last
concepts.spark: a girl with impossibly long hands stands inside a thin indigo border, drawn half in brush and half in the whiplash line of a paris poster, and the title above her was clearly lettered by the same hand that drew her sleeves.
concepts.webLeverage: css border and aspect-ratio panels, an svg drawn title that animates its stroke, and responsive margin annotations

concepts.form: a rubber-hose animation cel from the early sound era, boneless curving limbs and circular joints inked over a gray wash background, the whole scene framed by a round iris that opens and closes each gag
concepts.lineage: early sound-era American cel animation, rubber-hose limb construction, iris framing and beat-synced scene rhythm, 1930 to 1934
system: Palette/material: cel black and paper white with a single gray wash ground, everything drawn in one uniform confident ink weight
Type/composition: fat rounded display lettering with thick outlines, cards centered inside an oval vignette, no straight edges anywhere
Topology/navigation: scenes arrive through an iris that opens onto the next place, so the world is a sequence of gags rather than a plan
Controls/state: controls are rounded rubbery shapes that squash when pressed, and the active one keeps a small residual bounce
Responsive/motion: everything moves on a rhythm rather than a curve, and narrow frames tighten the iris rather than reflow the scene
concepts.spark: every arm in the frame bends like a garden hose, the buildings sway to the beat whether or not anyone is touching them, and the whole gag irises down to a black dot before the next one blinks open.
concepts.webLeverage: css clip-path iris transitions, squash-and-stretch keyframe animation on pointer state, and beat-synced motion timing

concepts.form: a custom shop panel finished in candy lacquer, freehand pinstripes laid on in mirrored pairs with a single loaded brush, a grotesque cartoon character airbrushed beside gothic script naming the car
concepts.lineage: California kustom culture pinstriping and monster-shirt airbrush art, car-show panel painting, 1955 to 1965
system: Palette/material: deep candy lacquer over metallic base, striping in one bright contrast plus white, and a flake ground that shifts with the light
Type/composition: gothic script naming across the lower panel, symmetrical stripe work radiating from a centerline, cartoon art breaking one edge
Topology/navigation: the panel is the unit, and moving means turning to the next panel in the show line rather than scrolling one surface
Controls/state: controls are striped teardrops, the active one gains a second mirrored stroke, and inactive ones hold a single line
Responsive/motion: stripe pairs mirror around the centerline at any width, and motion is a slow flake shimmer across the lacquer
concepts.spark: one loaded brush, no pencil line, no going back, and the second stripe has to match the first exactly. next to it a cartoon monster is driving something with twelve carburettors.
concepts.webLeverage: svg mirrored stroke paths generated responsive, a css flake shimmer animation, and pointer-driven lacquer highlight

concepts.form: a japanese street-fashion magazine spread packed to the edges, cut-out figures overlapping with handwritten price call-outs, glitter-outlined headlines and speech bubbles annotating every garment on the page
concepts.lineage: Japanese gyaru street-fashion magazine art direction, cut-out styling pages and handwritten call-out annotation, 1995 onward
system: Palette/material: hot pink, gold and tanned skin over white, with glitter outlines and star bursts printed as flat spot shapes
Type/composition: multiply outlined headlines, cut-out figures overlapping in a shingle, and handwritten price call-outs on leader lines to each garment
Topology/navigation: the spread is a crowd, so navigation is pulling one figure forward while the others keep overlapping behind
Controls/state: controls are call-out tags, the active one gains a second outline, and priced items keep a small star burst
Responsive/motion: the shingle restacks vertically on narrow frames, and motion is a figure lifting free of the overlap
concepts.spark: eleven girls cut out and shingled across two pages, every single item on them labelled by hand with a price and an arrow, and the headline outlined so many times it has its own gravity.
concepts.webLeverage: responsive shingle restacking, svg leader-line call-outs bound to hover state, and lift transforms on figure focus

concepts.form: a tokyo fancy-goods shop wall in faded pastel, plastic charms and pastel-printed stationery hung on pegs, everything reproduced at a slightly washed exposure as if it has sat in a sunlit window
concepts.lineage: the fairy kei pastel fancy-goods revival, 1980s Japanese stationery and charm shop merchandising, faded pastel print
system: Palette/material: sun-faded lilac, mint and baby blue on cream, every color one step lighter than it was printed, no full saturation anywhere
Type/composition: a rounded bubble face with soft outlines, goods hung on an even peg grid, and small cluster arrangements breaking the grid
Topology/navigation: the wall is a peg grid, so navigation is moving along pegs and lifting a cluster down to look at it
Controls/state: controls are pegs, the active one lifts its charm forward, and empty pegs stay visible as small shadows
Responsive/motion: the peg grid reflows in whole columns, and motion is a light swing as a charm is lifted from its peg
concepts.spark: a whole wall of pegs, every one carrying a small plastic thing in a color that used to be brighter, and one cluster in the corner arranged by somebody who cared a lot.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-column responsive peg grid, css swing animation on lift state, and empty-peg shadows driven by stock state

concepts.form: a scale model kit box lid, a painted action scene of the subject in weathered service across the face, with the runner diagram and stepped assembly sequence printed as flat technical line work on the side panel
concepts.lineage: Japanese scale model kit box art and instruction sheets, painted lid scenes over sprue runner diagrams, 1970s onward
system: Palette/material: a painted lid scene in muted service colors against flat technical line work, box board showing at the trimmed edges
Type/composition: a scale badge and kit number locked to one corner, painted scene owning the lid, numbered assembly steps ruled down the side panel
Topology/navigation: the world is an assembly sequence, so navigation advances a numbered step and the part is removed from the runner
Controls/state: controls are numbered parts on a runner, the active one detaches and seats, and used ones leave a visible stub
Responsive/motion: the runner diagram reflows in whole sprues, and motion is a part detaching and rotating into its seat
concepts.spark: a painted scene on the lid of something battered and in service, and on the side, printed flat and honest, every single part still attached to its runner with a number next to it.
concepts.webLeverage: an interactive svg runner diagram, step state advancing through the sequence, and part detach and rotate animation

concepts.form: a pulp magazine interior plate of a finned rocket over a red planet, airbrushed chrome hull and porthole rings against a starfield, the story title lettered in streamlined caps trailing speed lines
concepts.lineage: 1930s to 50s pulp science-fiction magazine illustration, finned rocket and ray-gun plate conventions, streamlined title lettering
system: Palette/material: oxidized red and deep space blue over pulp paper that yellows at the edges, hull rendered in airbrushed grays with no true white
Type/composition: streamlined caps trailing speed lines, the craft crossing on a strong diagonal, and a ruled caption box in one lower corner
Topology/navigation: everything travels a diagonal trajectory, so navigation follows the flight path from one plate to the next
Controls/state: controls are porthole rings, the active one lights from within, and inactive ones stay as dark rimmed circles
Responsive/motion: the diagonal re-angles to the frame and the craft holds scale, and motion is a speed-line trail with a slight drift
concepts.spark: a rocket with fins it does not need, crossing a red sky on a diagonal, trailing three speed lines the illustrator clearly enjoyed adding, and a title lettered like it is already going fast.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg flight path that re-angles responsive, speed-line trail animation, and porthole controls with lit state

concepts.form: an illustrated plate placing ancestral pattern into a speculative future, a beadwork-derived geometric border framing a starfield scene, the story title lettered inside a pattern cartouche at the head
concepts.lineage: the published Indigenous Futurisms illustration and anthology program, pattern-derived border craft in speculative publishing, 2003 onward
system: Palette/material: deep night blue and ochre with turquoise accents on warm stock, pattern printed flat with a fine keyline holding each unit
Type/composition: a geometric border built from a repeating pattern unit, a title cartouche set into the border head, and the scene held in the reserve
Topology/navigation: the border is the frame and the index, so navigation moves along pattern units that each open a chapter
Controls/state: controls are border units, the active one fills turquoise, and read ones take a small keyline notch
Responsive/motion: the border repeats in whole pattern units at any size, and motion is a unit lighting in sequence along the frame
concepts.spark: a border built from a pattern that has been in the family for six generations, framing a scene set four hundred years from now, and neither one is apologizing to the other.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg pattern border repeating in whole units responsive, sequenced unit animation, and chapter state per border unit

concepts.form: a sixties spy film title sequence built from dossier furniture, a target reticle sweeping across gridded surveillance frames with names typed in as if by a machine and a red classification stamp landing last
concepts.lineage: 1960s spy film title design and dossier graphics, surveillance frame grids, classification stamps and machine-typed credits
system: Palette/material: dossier manila and cold black with one alarm red, halftone surveillance frames printed coarse on matte stock
Type/composition: machine-typed credits landing letter by letter, a gridded frame array, and a red classification stamp set at an angle over it
Topology/navigation: the dossier is a case file, so navigation opens a numbered frame and its typed record
Controls/state: controls are frames, the active one takes the reticle, and cleared ones receive the classification stamp
Responsive/motion: the frame grid reflows in whole frames, and motion is a reticle sweep followed by a stamp landing hard
concepts.spark: a reticle drifting across a wall of surveillance frames, names typing themselves in one letter at a time, and then a red stamp landing at an angle over the whole thing.
concepts.webLeverage: an animated reticle sweep with typed credit state, whole-frame responsive grid, and a stamp landing animation

concepts.form: a character goods catalog page, a cast of rounded mascots ranked by popularity across a pastel grid, each with a name plate, a birthday, and a one-line personality note printed beneath its portrait
concepts.lineage: Japanese character goods catalog design, mascot roster pages with birthday and personality furniture, stationery merchandising
system: Palette/material: soft pastel grounds with a white keyline around every mascot, flat fills, and one saturated ribbon color per character
Type/composition: a rounded bubble face for name plates, mascots ranked in a grid, and a birthday with a one-line note ruled beneath each
Topology/navigation: the roster is ranked and finite, so navigation moves between characters and their fixed personal furniture
Controls/state: controls are mascot cells, the active one takes its ribbon color, and retired characters print in grayscale
Responsive/motion: the roster reflows in whole cells, and motion is a small bounce as a character takes focus
concepts.spark: forty-eight rounded characters ranked by how much people like them, each with a birthday and one line about what they enjoy, and one of them is a lump of butter.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-cell responsive roster, ranked ordering as live state, and a bounce animation on focus

concepts.form: an eighties toy catalogue spread in unmixed primaries, products photographed on a flat colored sweep and packed edge to edge, each with a burst price flash and a stock code ruled beneath
concepts.lineage: 1980s mail-order toy catalogue design, flat sweep product photography, burst price flashes and stock code conventions
system: Palette/material: unmixed primary red, yellow and blue as flat sweeps behind every product, printed on newsprint-grade catalogue paper
Type/composition: a heavy rounded sans, products packed edge to edge with no margin, a burst flash carrying each price and a code ruled beneath
Topology/navigation: the spread is dense and unranked, so navigation is scanning a packed field for the one you want
Controls/state: controls are product cells, the active one gains its burst flash, and sold-out ones strike the code
Responsive/motion: cells repack edge to edge at any width, and motion is a burst flash popping on selection
concepts.spark: every product photographed on a flat red or blue sweep and packed in with no room to breathe, each one with a starburst shouting the price and a stock code underneath for the order form.
concepts.webLeverage: an edge-to-edge responsive packing grid, burst flash pop animation, and stock state striking the code

concepts.form: a car body wrapped in printed vinyl, a character illustration scaled across the door and quarter panel with sponsor-style logo strips applied along the sill in deliberate racing arrangement
concepts.lineage: Japanese itasha printed vinyl car wrapping, character illustration scaled to body panels, sponsor-strip racing arrangement
system: Palette/material: printed vinyl gloss over body paint, saturated illustration color with a visible seam at every panel gap
Type/composition: illustration scaled to break across panels, sponsor-style logo strips ranged along the sill, and a number roundel on the door
Topology/navigation: panels are the layout, so navigation follows the art across a seam onto the next panel
Controls/state: controls are logo strips, the active one lifts to full gloss, and inactive ones sit matte against the vinyl
Responsive/motion: artwork rescales across whatever panels the frame gives it, and motion is a gloss highlight travelling a seam
concepts.spark: an illustration scaled so large it breaks across the door and the rear quarter, with a seam running right through it, and a row of sponsor logos along the sill for races that never happened.
concepts.webLeverage: responsive art scaling across panel breaks, a gloss highlight animation travelling seams, and logo strip state

concepts.form: a school-uniform subculture's dress code as a coded document, a lengthened pleated skirt and shortened sailor top annotated with rule callouts, group affiliation carried by embroidered collar stripes
concepts.lineage: Japanese sukeban school-uniform subculture, modified sailor uniform conventions and collar stripe affiliation coding, 1970s
system: Palette/material: navy serge and white cotton with a single embroidered stripe color per group, matte cloth with no shine anywhere
Type/composition: annotated rule callouts on leader lines to each modification, a plain condensed sans for labels, and a stripe key ruled at the foot
Topology/navigation: the garment is a document, so navigation follows a leader line from a modification to the rule that governs it
