concepts.webLeverage: scroll-spy anchor state, deep-linked headings, persisted language-tab preference, and a collapsing responsive tree

concepts.form: a pricing surface staged as ranked tiers with one deliberately recommended, a monthly and annual toggle that restates every figure, and a long feature matrix beneath where a sticky header keeps the column you are reading identified
concepts.lineage: the contemporary software pricing page school, recommended-tier emphasis, billing toggles and sticky comparison matrices
system: Palette/material: neutral card surfaces with one accent reserved entirely for the recommended tier, and a faint zebra on the matrix rows
Type/composition: tiers ranged as equal cards with the recommended one lifted, tabular figures for prices, and a dense matrix set small beneath
Topology/navigation: tiers compare horizontally and features compare vertically, so navigation crosses a grid rather than descending a page
Controls/state: controls are the billing toggle and tier cards, the active tier holds the accent, and unavailable features render as a muted dash
Responsive/motion: the matrix becomes one column per tier on phones with a sticky tier header, and motion is a figure counting between billing modes
concepts.spark: One tier is visibly the one they want you to pick, the toggle rewrites every number at once, and forty feet below there is a table that answers what the cards would not.
concepts.webLeverage: billing state rewriting tabular figures, a sticky matrix header, deep-linked tiers, and animated figure transitions

concepts.form: an operational status surface staged as ninety days of daily bars per service, green running to amber to red, with incident write-ups threaded beneath in reverse order and each carrying its own timeline of updates
concepts.lineage: the public status page school, ninety-day uptime bar histories and threaded incident post-mortems, 2015 onward
system: Palette/material: calm neutral ground with a three-step severity ramp used nowhere except the bars and badges, and generous white around everything
Type/composition: a plain sans at a trustworthy size, per-service rows of thin daily bars, and incident entries ranged as timestamped updates
Topology/navigation: the bar row is the index, so navigation clicks a bad day and lands in the incident that caused it
Controls/state: controls are day bars, the active one opens its incident, and resolved incidents keep a struck badge with a duration
Responsive/motion: the ninety-day row compresses in whole bars and never truncates silently, and motion is a bar expanding into its detail
concepts.spark: Eighty-eight green bars, one amber, one red, and clicking the red one tells you exactly what happened and how long it took to admit it.
concepts.webLeverage: live status polling, day-bar state deep-linked to incidents, whole-bar responsive compression, and expand transitions

concepts.form: a long-form editorial surface where a measured column carries the argument and full-bleed figures interrupt it at intervals, pull quotes breaking the measure, a thin progress rule at the head and estimated reading time declared before the first paragraph
concepts.lineage: the contemporary web longread school, measured columns interrupted by full-bleed figures with pull quotes and reading progress
system: Palette/material: a warm paper ground with one ink, figures running edge to edge without frames, and a single accent on the progress rule
Type/composition: a serif at a generous measure, pull quotes set large and hung outside the column, and figures breaking full width with small captions
Topology/navigation: the piece is one continuous descent, so navigation is reading position rather than sections, with the rule reporting it
Controls/state: controls are figures and quotes, an active figure expands past the measure, and read progress persists between visits
Responsive/motion: the measure holds at all widths while figures crop rather than shrink, and motion is a progress rule advancing
concepts.spark: The column stays exactly as wide as it should be for as long as it takes, and every few screens a picture takes the whole width and earns it.
concepts.webLeverage: scroll-driven progress state, reading position persisted local, and responsive figure cropping that preserves the measure

concepts.form: a design system site where every component is shown live beside its own code, props exposed as toggles that change the rendered specimen in place, and a token table linking each value to everywhere it is used
concepts.lineage: the contemporary design system documentation school, live component specimens with prop toggles and linked token tables, 2019 onward
system: Palette/material: a neutral documentation chrome deliberately quieter than the components it displays, with specimens on a faint checkered ground
Type/composition: a component specimen framed above its code, prop controls ranged beside it, and token tables set in tabular figures
Topology/navigation: the system is a component index, so navigation moves between components and then between their states
Controls/state: controls are prop toggles, changing one rerenders the specimen and rewrites the code beneath it to match
Responsive/motion: the specimen frame resizes independently of the page so components can be tested small, and motion is a rerender settle
concepts.spark: Flip the disabled toggle and both the button and the code sample underneath change at the same time, which is the only honest way to document a component.
concepts.webLeverage: live prop state rerendering specimens and code together, an independently resizable specimen frame, and token cross-linking

concepts.form: a long form staged so every field explains itself, validation arriving on blur rather than on keystroke, errors written as sentences beneath the field they belong to, and a summary at the head linking to the first thing that needs attention
concepts.lineage: the contemporary accessible form design school, blur-timed validation with sentence errors and linked error summaries
system: Palette/material: a plain ground with generous field spacing, one alert color used only on errors, and a green reserved for confirmed completion
Type/composition: one field per row with its label above and help text below, errors set as full sentences, and a summary block at the head
Topology/navigation: the form is a single ordered pass, so navigation descends fields and the summary jumps back to the first unresolved one
Controls/state: fields are untouched, focused, valid, or in error, and an error persists until corrected rather than clearing on the next keystroke
Responsive/motion: fields stay full width at every size, and motion is a summary appearing and an error settling beneath its field
concepts.spark: It waits until you have finished typing before telling you anything, and when it does object it writes a sentence rather than turning the box red.
concepts.webLeverage: blur-timed validation state, an error summary with focus management, and aria-describedby wiring per field

concepts.form: a bath of thickened water where pigment floats and is combed into figures before being lifted onto paper in one contact, every mark made by moving liquid rather than by drawing on a surface
concepts.lineage: Ottoman ebru marbling, gum tragacanth baths, comb and stylus figure work and single-contact paper lifting
system: Palette/material: pigment floating on a thickened bath, colours never mixing but displacing each other, lifted onto sized paper in a single contact
Type/composition: figures drawn by dragging a stylus through floating colour, with each new drop pushing the previous ones outward into rings
Topology/navigation: everything is made on one surface in one pass, so navigation is intervening in a liquid rather than moving between views
Controls/state: controls are stylus strokes, each one permanently displaces the colour around it, and a lift ends the composition
Responsive/motion: the bath fills any frame and figures redistribute, and motion is pigment displacing outward from each new drop
concepts.spark: Every drop pushes the last one into a ring, and you comb through the whole thing with a single hair before laying a sheet down once and lifting the only copy there will ever be.
concepts.webLeverage: a fluid-displacement canvas simulation with stylus interaction, irreversible stroke state, and a one-shot lift transition

concepts.form: the in-world handbook packed with a boxed adventure game, read as a wall of backlit plates where a saturated matte surrounds a dark schoolbook type well, and any line may be printed latent in the matte's own hue until the reader strikes it into bone
concepts.lineage: Infocom's grey-box era in-world documentation booklets and their InvisiClues hint books, Cambridge Massachusetts 1984 to 1987, with the packaging and print program by Giardini/Russell
concepts.spark: A stapled handbook page lies on a light table in an unlit room: its margin burns sulphur yellow, the paragraph inside sits bone on near-black, and under the numbered question three answers are still invisible in the yellow until a marker drags across the first one and it comes up.
system: Palette/material: bone type and box black over eight lamps (alarm red, amber, sulphur, dial green, aqua, ink blue, plum, magenta rose), each on a four-step OKLCH luminance ladder.
Type/composition: Century Schoolbook at 17px on 1.62 leading, measure held at 62-68 characters; Trade Gothic Bold Condensed caps at 2.2 body on the header band; mono for codes.
Topology/navigation: nothing touches the viewport edge; plates are inset by a gutter, so the outermost thing is always black field. Navigation is the numbered plate index.
Controls/state: any line may be printed latent in its matte's hue until struck into bone; one plate is up, the rest held one step down. Struck bullets fill, latent stay hollow.
Responsive/motion: nothing eases; a state change is a lamp switch in one frame. Prose stays in the dark type well while the matte absorbs the width, then plates gain columns.
concepts.webLeverage: Each plate declares one --lamp hue and derives its four steps (latent, held, struck, up) in OKLCH at fixed offsets, so the contrast floor is structural. State is two attributes; media rides the ladder through one brightness filter.

concepts.form: A single vacuum-formed, screen-printed control fascia where a whole plant flow diagram is printed edge to edge across one unbroken plane, action keys pillowed proud of it and entry fields debossed into shallow chalk trays sunk beneath the printed terrain.
concepts.lineage: Pillow-embossed screen-printed membrane fascias and mimic-diagram control panels of 1970s-80s municipal waterworks, dairy and pumping-station process rooms.
concepts.spark: A dairy plant fascia at shift change: one putty plane, teal process line running wall to wall through pillow-raised orange keys, each shallow chalk tray filled in pencil, sulphur tick scales down both margins, a debossed plate number in the corner.
system: Palette/material: ink on one putty thermoform plane: navy, process teal, signal orange, sulphur, chalk. Foreign images seat in debossed chalk trays; printed lines stop at the rim.
Type/composition: one size only, tracked caps for labels, navy prose only inside chalk trays; rank by weight and keyline count. Everything lands on the 8mm key module.
Topology/navigation: one 6px process line enters at the left margin and threads every group at 0, 45 or 90 degrees; stations hang off it in order, and it switchbacks when narrow.
Controls/state: raised = actionable, inset = editable, flush with a dotted keyline = unavailable; hatched face = pending, struck corner to corner = failed, 30% dot screen = stale.
Responsive/motion: dashes on every line drift one way at a constant 8px per second and freeze dead on failure; presses change relief only, and panels reflow by key module.
concepts.webLeverage: Two shadow recipes on one ground token: raised is a 1px light edge top-left plus a 3px flat shelf lower-right, inset is the reverse, and every control is one of the two. Routes are SVG paths with dashoffset drifting at a fixed 8px/s.
avoid: No neumorphism: relief is a hard printed highlight and a flat shadow shelf on committed colour, never blurred grey on grey.
No brushed metal, chrome bezels or glossy plastic highlights; the plane is matt printed stock throughout.
No hazard chevrons, stencil warning slabs or industrial-hazard cosplay; this is a civic waterworks fascia and copy stays plain.

concepts.form: An admin table built as a solid-state pinball backbox: rows are painted legends on a speckled black board lit from beneath by an insert-lamp matrix, grouped by raked lanes of coloured light, with a giant bonus-multiplier ladder standing where a totals row would be.
concepts.lineage: Solid-state pinball backbox and playfield logic, Bally and Williams 1977-1991: insert-lamp matrices, drop-target banks, and bonus multiplier ladders.
concepts.spark: A backbox opened at its hinge under shop light: a packed grid of translucent plastic inserts, half lit amber and cobalt through speckled paint, one dropped target leaving a black hole, and a multiplier ladder glowing at the top rung.
system: Palette/material: speckled black lacquer board drenched in lamp light: amber, cherry, green, cobalt, violet, warm white, ply cream; at least two lit; foreign images stay untinted.
Type/composition: stencil-edged condensed caps, horizontal on a packed grid; lit lanes rake diagonally across the rows; one giant tally per view against tiny legends.
Topology/navigation: three stacked layers: painted board, lamps beneath, scratched glass above; regions are lit lanes, never boxes; the current lane stays lit edge to edge.
Controls/state: unlit legend reads as dry relief, lit as a halo bleed, done rows carry a struck bar, removed rows leave a black cavity, blocked rows read TILT struck across.
Responsive/motion: no fades or travel; every change is a one-step jump between two lit levels; narrow views shed lanes, keep the tally; only the ladder stretches.
concepts.webLeverage: Grouping carried by raked radial lamp-glow gradients behind rows instead of dividers, plus a token system where every state also carries a non-colour mark: dry relief, struck bar, or punched black cavity.
avoid: No painted backglass pin-up art, no chrome plungers, flipper bats or ball-bearing gloss anywhere in the furniture.
No attract-mode flashing, chasing or pulsing; lamps hold a single level at rest and jump only when state does.
No dead grey rows: an unlit row still shows the board's colour wash, speckled grain and relief legend.

concepts.form: A working field built as a darkroom printer's exposure record: overlapping translucent sheets over a backlit eleven-step zone ramp, where any region carries a hatch density and a stop-delta, and two hatches crossing at ninety degrees mark a conflict.
concepts.lineage: Photographic printers' exposure record cards and f-stop dodge-and-burn maps, 1940s-1980s darkrooms, over Adams and Archer's 1940 eleven-zone tonal scale.
concepts.spark: A taped record card under the enlarger's glow: ruled boxes of seconds and M-filtration numbers, and a tracing-paper overlay askew on top where one region is hatched +1 1/3 and a corner is outlined to be held back.
system: Palette/material: Backlit neutrals snapped to an eleven-step zone ramp; one glowing dichroic magenta marks filtration only; hosted images sit in a two-step mask, never hatched.
Type/composition: Legends in tracked condensed caps, quantities in tabular mono with 1/3 and 2/3 fractions; prose sits only on cleared light zones, hatching halting a line short.
Topology/navigation: Stacked translucent sheets overlap at slight angles, each squared internally; navigating slides a sheet aside instead of replacing the field beneath.
Controls/state: dotted outline is held back, deepest zone is selected, a struck rule is disabled, hatch density is load; two hatches crossing at ninety degrees is a conflict.
Responsive/motion: Sheets carry mass, sliding with slight overshoot before settling; narrow widths stack them one per column with the zone wedge repeating at each band head.
concepts.webLeverage: An eleven-step zone ramp as the only tonal tokens, plus a hatch layer where any region takes a numeric weight and a stop-delta, and overlapping regions cross-hatch so conflict renders without colour.
avoid: No darkroom props: no enlargers, safelight bulbs, tongs, trays or curling prints; this world is sheets, ramps, hatching and numbers only.
No photographs, negatives, contact sheets or grain texture standing in for content; a subject appears only as its exposure terrain.
Do not let the ramp settle into flat dead grey: the wedge must reach true black and bare white, and the magenta must actually emit.

concepts.form: A working plane built as a die-struck enamel plate: irregular fired colour cells drench the ground and run off the frame, while every control sits above them in bare nickel, raised where you may act and sunk to an empty well where you may type, so no hue ever touches a thing you can press.
concepts.lineage: Die-struck soft-enamel badge and champleve plate artwork: the colour-separation proof sheets of Japanese and American trading-pin makers, 1964 onward.
concepts.spark: A pin-maker's proof plate under a bench lamp: lapis, chrome yellow and sang cells fired hard against die-struck nickel walls, one cell left sandblasted and empty where the enamel never went in, and a struck legend so large it runs straight off the edge of the metal.
system: Palette/material: ground is fired enamel in lapis, turquoise, sang, chrome yellow, orange, grass, aubergine, ivory; furniture is bare satin nickel; foreign media gets a nickel mat.
Type/composition: legends are die-struck condensed grotesk reversed from their cell at 4.5:1; running prose sits only in inset nickel troughs; one legend runs off the frame.
Topology/navigation: enamel cells tessellate and run off every edge; nickel furniture floats over them on one shared baseline rail that carries navigation, so rows stay aligned.
Controls/state: raised = actionable, inset well = editable, flush shadowless = disabled, knurled = pending, chisel-crossed = failed, drilled through = gone; rank is relief height.
Responsive/motion: relief changes in one 90ms step between three fixed shadow lengths, never a fade; the cell field stretches on its long axis and nothing reflows.
concepts.webLeverage: Ship three relief tokens (flat, 2px, 6px hard shadows, no blur ramp, no easing, switched in one step) plus a build-time gate that refuses any enamel hue on a focusable element, so colour is generated for ground only.
avoid: No pins, clutches, domed glaze or badges on fabric: this is a fired plate read flat on, never an object photographed.
No brushed-metal bezels, screws, rivets or gloss reflections; relief is geometry plus one hard shadow, not chrome rendering.
Cells must not settle into equal rounded rectangles on a grid, and no hue may leak onto a button, tab, field or focus ring.

concepts.form: A worked queue rebuilt as a chart plate: one raked five-unit ruling carries each item as a column of small coloured carets, the live item lifted onto a frosted glass leaf while the rest compress to thin mark columns behind it.
concepts.lineage: The printed anaesthesia record, mid-century North American hospital forms c.1935-1965: five-minute rulings, caret and circle plotting symbols, drug bars, inked event stiles.
concepts.spark: A finished record sheet on a lit glass viewer: pale green rulings, a sawtooth of oxblood and prussian carets marching across it, one hatched bar running under three columns, and a single vertical stile inked where something happened at 10:42.
system: Palette/material: frosted and slate glass on bone stock, grid ruled ozone green; seven mark inks, oxblood to graphite; only vermilion fills area; foreign images sit behind glass.
Type/composition: ruled terrain rakes at one fixed shallow diagonal; all type stays level; running prose sits on milk-frosted glass with the rulings suppressed beneath it.
Topology/navigation: one plate holds the front leaf, its caret column drawn four times larger; the rest sit compressed behind glass; no plate reaches the frame edge.
Controls/state: state is a plotted mark: caret down pending, caret up done, hatched bar running, struck stile failed, ringed mark confirmed, a row ruled through is void.
Responsive/motion: marks land one grid column at a time, never tweened; the terrain steps in whole five-unit jumps; narrow widths drop rake columns, never rescale marks.
concepts.webLeverage: Every row renders as an SVG caret column computed from its own values on one shared raked ruling; selection promotes a row to a 4x plate on a frosted layer, and state changes snap to whole grid columns.
avoid: No hospital dressing: no patient names, vital-sign drama, clipboards, monitors, ECG traces or medical iconography. Take the marking system only.
Do not let the seven mark inks spread into fills or gradients; they stay hairline carets and circles on neutral glass, vermilion excepted.
No smooth scrolling terrain, no bevelled chrome, lens flare or glossy 3D glass; the leaves read as flat frosted sheets.

concepts.form: A monitoring surface built from a bridge watch log's printed form: a sticky stub column of ruled index cells, horizontal watch bands in log-blue, and a wrong value left in place, struck once, with the correction inked above it and initials in a narrow box beside.
concepts.lineage: Merchant-marine bell books, engine order logs and Admiralty deck log forms, roughly 1900-1975, with Admiralty chart ink conventions where cautionary matter prints magenta.
concepts.spark: A watch log open under a chart-table lamp at 03:40: one figure struck through by a single ruled line, the corrected figure inked above it, two initials in the narrow box at the margin, and a magenta legend stamped hard across the blue watch band.
system: Palette/material: Buff litho tooth; log-blue owns ruling, stubs, bands; legends in black, red, magenta, green, ochre, yellow; foreign media becomes a ruled exhibit.
Type/composition: Modular column grid, tabular mono entries, condensed caps legends; prose in cleared buff lanes. One legend per view runs at band height, frame-cropped.
Topology/navigation: A sticky stub column at left is the whole navigation; the field beside it is banded, each band closed by a double rule and a carry-forward mark.
Controls/state: A superseded value is struck once, corrected above, initialed beside; a diagonal cancels, a bracket pends, a doubled box selects; rank is rule weight.
Responsive/motion: Values settle like a damped pointer, overshooting once; the field advances by whole ruled lines, never fading. Narrow widths drop right columns, not the stub.
concepts.webLeverage: Corrections are append-only in the DOM: a changed value keeps its old glyphs under a one-pixel ruled strike with an initial box appended; band row heights compute from the content's own counts; numbers settle on a damped spring.
avoid: No brass telegraph dials, ship's wheels, portholes, rope or bezels; take the form's ruling, legends and stamps, never the bridge itself.
No tea-stained parchment, deckled edges, compass roses or cursive script used as texture; every entry is a legible printed or inked mark.
No sepia retreat into greys: the legend inks must appear and log-blue must stay saturated rather than drifting to slate.

concepts.form: An access-control surface built as a cathode numeral stack: every possible value present at once as a dark ghost behind a fine bronze anode gauze, one struck forward in glowing orange, with no box, rule or divider anywhere on a plane that runs past every edge.
concepts.lineage: Cold-cathode nixie readouts of Burroughs and Rodan decade counters, 1955 to 1972, and the anode-gauze faces of laboratory scaler panels.
concepts.spark: A decade counter at 2am: the numeral 4 blazing orange while nine unlit sisters hang behind it in the same glass, faint wire outlines crossed by the mesh of the anode gauze, the tube stack throwing warm light onto blue-black bench felt.
system: Palette/material: two hues, ink-blue black and cathode orange, on fine bronze wire gauze; roles: ground, gauze, ghost, glow. Imported photos stay untinted under a gauze veil.
Type/composition: one condensed numeral-derived display face against bone-white body prose; labels may align, but the ghost layer behind them overlaps freely at differing depths.
Topology/navigation: the gauze plane runs past every edge unframed; no rules, boxes or dividers, grouping is gauze density and depth; prose columns clear the mesh entirely.
Controls/state: all options sit present as unlit ghosts behind the gauze; the chosen one is struck forward, crisp and haloed; stale keeps a decayed afterglow; refused stays dark.
Responsive/motion: values snap, never tween; the old glow decays over one beat as the new strikes. Width adds ghost depth to the stack, never new columns or framing.
concepts.webLeverage: Render every alternative in the DOM at once: unlit states as low-opacity ghost text staggered in depth behind a repeating SVG mesh, the active one promoted by a hard opacity and blur step with no transition.
avoid: No glass tube, socket, bezel or brushed metal; the gauze and the glow are graphic layers, never a photographed instrument.
No dead greys or sooty near-black wash; the ground stays a saturated ink blue and the struck glow a true hot orange.
No glyph rain, no seven-segment forms, no orange running copy; body prose is bone-white on the darkest ground.

concepts.form: A resumable configuration surface drawn as a jackfield normalling schedule: numbered lanes on unlit black glass where every item is tied to its default by an amber link line that is unbroken, cross-ticked, gapped, doubled or ended in an open ring.
concepts.lineage: Studio and broadcast patchbay normalling schedules: ADC and Bantam TT jackfield legend strips and BBC Designs Department wiring charts, 1968-1985
concepts.spark: A backlit schedule taped inside a machine-room door: amber lanes numbered 01 to 48 on black glass, a solid tie line running to each default, and one line interrupted by a neat hand-inked gap where the operator broke the normal and left it broken.
system: Palette/material: black glass ground, one signal amber for every mark; foreign photos keep their own colour inside an amber hairline frame with a filled amber caption bar.
Type/composition: one condensed grotesque: small-cap legends, upright prose. Rank is inversion, the dominant block knocked dark out of a solid amber plate, one per screen.
Topology/navigation: an endless lane grid drifts under a fixed left legend strip; dark gutters at both edges mean nothing spans full width, and panels snap to numbered lanes.
Controls/state: each item carries a link line: unbroken is live, one cross-tick held, a clean gap disabled, doubled selected, open ring end destructive; no colour carries state.
Responsive/motion: lanes drift one hairline per second under static type; narrow widths drop lanes, never the edge gutters, and a broken link line never animates closed.
concepts.webLeverage: Every row owns an SVG link rail whose state is drawn by stroke pattern rather than hue: unbroken, cross-tick, gap, doubled, open ring. Lane numbers are durable anchors, so any surface can be re-entered where it broke.
avoid: No drawn patchbay: no jacks, bezels, screws, brushed metal or looping cables; the chart exists, the machine does not.
No CRT bloom, scanlines or phosphor decay; the amber is flat emitted light, not a simulated tube.
No second hue smuggled in for warnings or success; a warning is a broken line, never a red one.

concepts.form: A late-hour selection rack: courses of typed ivory title strips seated in a channel behind smoked glass, each opening with a boxed letter-number address, riding proud of the glass when live and lapping over its neighbour only where two claims land on the same address.
concepts.lineage: Seeburg and Wurlitzer title-strip selection panels and diner wallboxes, 1948-1962, and the narrow title-strip typewriter that set their two-line paper slips.
concepts.spark: At 2 a.m. the rack glows amber through smoked glass: forty typed ivory strips in courses, one pasted over with a dated correction slip, two lapping over each other at K-7 with the overlap seam lit bright.
system: Palette/material: amber light-well under glass; all copy rides on opaque ivory paper in graphite; coded ruby, tangerine, jade, cobalt, violet bands. Foreign media mounts as strips.
Type/composition: condensed gothic caps for the title line, italic for any second line, a boxed letter-number slug at each strip's left; courses stop short of both margins.
Topology/navigation: two lit colour pilasters bracket every surface, so nothing bleeds to an edge; everything is addressed by a letter-number pair and reached by stepping courses.
Controls/state: flush at rest, proud with shadow when actionable, inset when editable, struck with typed slashes when dead, pasted slip when superseded; rank doubles strip height.
Responsive/motion: courses advance a whole strip at a time, nothing eases; light steps one stop brighter behind a proud strip; two claims on one address overlap with a lit seam.
concepts.webLeverage: Every addressable item carries a stable boxed letter-number address; two items claiming one address render as overlapped strips with a lit overlap seam instead of a warning banner, computed from the data.
avoid: No jukebox object: no chrome bezel, arched cabinet, bubble tubes or visible mechanism. This is the marking system, not the machine.
No diner nostalgia: no checkerboard floor, cherry vinyl, script neon or fifties pin-up lettering anywhere in the furniture.
Coded edge bands must code something legible; scattered rainbow edges with no legend read as decoration and drop the rack to dead grey.

concepts.form: An admin sheet printed as a continuous chain-printer listing: one drenched bar-green ground generated per line, black impact ink for every mark and control, a two-character result-code rail down each panel edge, and overlapping fold panels where a promoted item is restated as a banner word built from its own repeated glyphs.
concepts.lineage: Chain-printer output on 14 7/8-inch fanfold greenbar, 1959-1985: banner separator pages, carriage-control channels, overstrike, and condition codes read down the listing gutter.
concepts.spark: A night-run listing fanned open on a lit glass table at 4 a.m., the bars glowing green from beneath, one fold carrying the word HOLD two hands high and made of thousands of tiny letter H's, the code rail down its edge reading 00, 00, 12.
system: Palette/material: One hue: lit bar green #6FB894 drenched edge to edge, glowing from behind; all marks matte black ink. Supplied images sit on unprinted white, never overprinted.
Type/composition: One monospace at three sizes, black on green at a 66-character measure; rank is a banner word built of its own repeated glyphs. Panels overlap; rows align.
Topology/navigation: One continuous sheet; nav lives in a top gutter strip and a code rail down one edge, both always present. Moving steps the sheet by whole folds, never slides.
Controls/state: State is ink weight, not hue. Selected reverses the band to solid ink, text knockout; pending half-strike; disabled a carbon ghost; failed overstruck with its code.
Responsive/motion: All motion snaps in whole line pitches, no easing. Destructive controls sit past a punched perforation and take a tear. Narrow widths raise bar pitch, not type.
concepts.webLeverage: Bar bands are computed from line-height, not imagery: a repeating gradient locked to the line box so every row lands in a band, selection fills its band and knocks the text out, scroll snaps to line pitch, bar pitch is one variable.
avoid: No drawn printer, tractor sprockets, torn perf confetti, coffee rings or nostalgia dust; the sheet is a generated ground, not a photographed relic.
Not phosphor: this is black ink on lit green paper, never green glyphs on black, and never glyph rain or ASCII art used as decoration.
Do not let the green go olive or the ink go grey; bar green stays bright and ink stays full black or the sheet reads as a beige template.

concepts.form: A worked queue built from a cracktro title screen: one bitmap face riding baselines over an emissive black void, where rank is depth, fields of grey dust drift behind the work at layered speeds, and nothing is ever enclosed by a rule or a box.
concepts.lineage: Amiga and PC demoscene cracktro and intro screens, roughly 1987 to 1995: sine scrollers, parallax starfields and bitmap fonts on black.
concepts.spark: At 2am one ivory line of bitmap text sits dead still on a black screen while three fields of grey pinpricks drift behind it at different speeds, and a single amber caret blinks at the head of the line.
system: Palette/material: emissive black void, four dust neutrals ash to ivory, one signal amber; prose is ivory on void only; foreign images sit unretouched on the void, never tinted.
Type/composition: one bitmap face at two sizes; all text rides baselines on a single unit; overlap allowed, enclosure never; no rules, boxes or dividers.
Topology/navigation: layers stacked front to back; every baseline continues past both screen edges, so nothing is contained; navigating means pulling a layer forward.
Controls/state: state is depth: brightness step plus letterspacing plus drift rate; the frontmost brightest widest item outranks all; a reversed glyph cell marks failure.
Responsive/motion: only rear layers drift, one slow rate halved per step forward; the front plane holds still while read; narrow widths drop depth steps, not brightness steps.
concepts.webLeverage: Every element declares an integer depth; one stylesheet maps depth to brightness step, letterspacing and drift rate off a single shared clock, and focus freezes the front plane to full stillness.
avoid: No Matrix glyph rain, green phosphor or falling katakana; the void carries drifting one-pixel dust, not code.
No chrome-bevelled logos, copper raster bars, metallic gradient wordmarks or scene-group greetz slang in rendered copy.
No nebula or space photography; stars are dust at four brightness steps, not astronomy.

concepts.form: A monitoring surface built as a depot destination blind: bias-cut courses of dyed duck cloth stacked in a roll stepping under one fixed window, where anything wrong is the course stopped mid-step, showing two half-legends meeting across a single seam.
concepts.lineage: Linen and Tyvek roller destination blinds of British and German bus and tram depots, 1930s-1980s, and the Solari flap indicator, Udine 1956.
concepts.spark: A blind lifted onto the depot bench at 4:40 a.m. and lit from behind: green duck cloth halted between two courses, the top half of one destination and the bottom half of the next meeting at one seam, every thread glowing through the chrome-yellow letters.
system: Palette/material: three dyes only: bottle-green duck cloth drenched, chrome-yellow legends, bleached calico carries all prose; foreign images are matted on cloth and never tinted.
Type/composition: one condensed grotesque, caps, one size; panels cut on a 12-degree bias, type level inside; rank is inversion: the lead panel alone prints dark on pale cloth.
Topology/navigation: content rides a roll of stacked cloth courses that step under one fixed window inset from the trim; a punched eyelet tape down one edge is the index.
Controls/state: controls take no dye, only stitch, punch and relief; a fault stops its row mid-step, showing two half-legends over one seam; stale wears thin, dead bares the weave.
Responsive/motion: nothing glides; every change snaps one course, overshoots, settles; narrow screens drop courses, never shrink type; lit from behind so the weave stays visible.
concepts.webLeverage: Build the step for real: any changing cell is a strip translated in whole line-heights with a one-step overshoot, and a stalled half-step showing two clipped legends across a seam is the only error state.
avoid: No depicted blind box, roller drum, screws or brushed bezels; the cloth is the surface, not a machine drawn on it.
No airport flap board in black and white with yellow accents; the ground stays a dyed, drenched green everywhere.
No burlap photo overlay or wrinkled fabric imagery; the weave is printed structure at one consistent scale.

concepts.form: A working plate where every element registers against one off-centre calibrated rail, colour survives only as hairline emission lines of seven wavelengths standing on a procedurally banded charcoal continuum, and state is carried in line height, dash and doubling rather than hue.
concepts.lineage: Photographic emission-line spectrograms and comparison-arc plates from observatory and analytical spectroscopy, roughly 1890 to 1960, and their printed wavelength tables.
concepts.spark: A glass spectrogram lying on a low viewing box at three in the morning: a grey continuum crossed by needle-thin bright lines, every legend at the same tiny size, one sodium pair doubled and standing brighter than anything near it.
system: Palette/material: procedural charcoal continuum with bone legends; colour only as hairlines at 405/436/486/546/589/615/656nm; foreign images mat into graphite, edged by one line.
Type/composition: one grotesque at a single size, ranked by tracking and ink; all matter hangs off one off-centre rail, and prose only ever sits in bone on flat ash plates.
Topology/navigation: every destination is a tick on the rail; the open one blooms into a giant plate above it, the rest stay hairline stubs, and nothing ever leaves the rail.
Controls/state: state is line form, not hue: full-height solid live, dashed pending, half-height stale, struck disabled; a doubled line, sodium yellow, outranks its neighbours.
Responsive/motion: a landing line slides to its position and damps with one overshoot; narrow widths shorten the band shown, never the type; sheets behind the top one dim a step.
concepts.webLeverage: Build the rail as one custom property mapping any value to an x position; every mark is a 1px absolutely placed line whose state is height, dash pattern and doubling, settled by a spring, never by colour.
avoid: No depicted spectrometer, prism, brass tube or optical bench; take the plate's marking system, never the instrument.
No rainbow gradients or full-spectrum washes; the seven hues exist only as hairlines against worked grey.
No dead all-grey render either: every one of the seven line hues must be present and distinguishable at a glance.

families.label: Earth & Water Worlds
families.description: Terrain, stone, rivers, oceans, clouds, storms, and the forces that continually remake a planet.

concepts.form: a hurricane organized around an uncanny calm eye, with spiral rainbands, asymmetric wind, and an evolving eyewall replacement
concepts.lineage: tropical-cyclone science and satellite-image choreography; grounded in meteorological visualization, atmospheric field observation, environmental installation, and sky photography
system: Palette/material: basin gray-blue cloud decks as ground, the sunlit eye white-gold at center, hazard arcs in warning coral as the active alert color
Type/composition: condensed advisory caps with monospaced timing digits, copy set in radial bands around a center kept empty and calm
Topology/navigation: Navigate basin view, rainband, eyewall, eye, and local hazard arc.
Controls/state: Scrub intensity, choose radius, and show forming, strengthening, replacing, and weakening states.
Responsive/motion: Use radial bands plus a local timeline on phones; never loop destructive imagery decoratively.
concepts.spark: The viewer passes through screaming cloud into a sunlit circular calm, then watches a second wall form outside it.
concepts.webLeverage: GPU cloud volumes and vector fields couple storm structure to measured wind.

concepts.form: a newly formed cloud edge diffracting sunlight through similarly sized droplets, with pastel bands shifting as droplet distribution and angular distance from the sun change
concepts.lineage: optical meteorology, cloud microphysics, safe sky observation, spectral photography, and immersive color-field installation
system: Palette/material: plain cloud white ground with slate gray body ink, a narrow fringe of mint, rose, and violet at the edge, violet marking the active band
Type/composition: quiet thin humanist sans, wide white margins, color confined to hairline band edges while the text field stays achromatic
Topology/navigation: Move between cloud body, droplet-size sample, angular color band, observation moment, and competing explanation.
Controls/state: Adjust droplet distribution, compare images, mark uncertainty, and inspect absent, forming, vivid, and dispersed states.
Responsive/motion: Stack image, spectrum, and droplet evidence on phones; never require device motion or direct viewing near the sun.
concepts.spark: A plain white cloud grows a narrow crown of mint, rose, and violet; minutes later the droplets broaden in size and the entire spectral edge dissolves.
concepts.webLeverage: Local image analysis, a droplet-diffraction model, and shareable comparison states let users test observed bands against particle-size hypotheses while retaining safe-viewing guidance and semantic spectra.

concepts.form: a monsoon wall arriving across a dry landscape, with advancing dust edge, temperature drop, first rain, and sudden surface renewal
concepts.lineage: seasonal weather observation and landscape time-lapse; grounded in meteorological visualization, atmospheric field observation, environmental installation, and sky photography
system: Palette/material: parched ochre and tan ground before the front, the wall in dust brown, rain slate gray, returning leaf green reserved for the renewed active state
Type/composition: field-journal grotesk with dated entries, the page split as a horizontal before-front-after band, notes stamped at the moment of arrival
Topology/navigation: Navigate prefront landscape, dust boundary, rain core, runoff, and poststorm response.
Controls/state: Scrub arrival, inspect place, and show waiting, overtaken, raining, and renewed states.
Responsive/motion: Use a horizontal before-front-after sequence on phones; motion remains user-controlled.
concepts.spark: A brown wall swallows the horizon; the wind flips, rain strikes hot ground, and dormant color returns.
concepts.webLeverage: Terrain particles, wetness shaders, and vegetation state blending stage the transformation.

concepts.form: a rotating supercell rising like a vast atmospheric cathedral, with layered inflow, suspended vaults, and a rain-wrapped core
concepts.lineage: storm structure studies and panoramic severe-weather imaging; grounded in meteorological visualization, atmospheric field observation, environmental installation, and sky photography
system: Palette/material: darkened prairie umber ground, slate cloud vaults stacked above, anvil white-gray at the top, hail-core green as the charged accent light
Type/composition: condensed caps stacked by altitude like a storm section, labels ruled to horizontal stratification, the vertical axis ordering all copy
Topology/navigation: Navigate inflow, wall cloud, updraft, anvil, and precipitation through a vertical storm section.
Controls/state: Adjust humidity and shear, and show organizing, mature, cycling, and collapsing states.
Responsive/motion: Turn the storm into stacked sectional layers on phones; cloud motion slows under
concepts.spark: Low clouds race inward beneath a vaulted mothership while green light gathers around the hidden core.
concepts.webLeverage: Volumetric ray marching and wind-vector particles reveal internal storm architecture.

concepts.form: a basalt column field rising like a stone organ, with cooling fractures, hexagonal rhythms, and broken coastal edges
concepts.lineage: volcanic geology, architectural rhythm, and natural stone craft; grounded in geological field craft, mineral collections, scientific illustration, and immersive earth-history exhibitions
system: Palette/material: wet basalt charcoal-black ground, rain-sheen gray on column tops, surf foam white at the broken edge, one lichen ochre patch as the accent
Type/composition: heavy grotesk set in tall narrow columns of even width, a strict hexagonal rhythm, the ragged coastal break allowed only at the page edge
Topology/navigation: Navigate field rhythm, column cluster, fracture junction, and cooling history.
Controls/state: Change cooling rate, isolate polygons, and show liquid, cracking, mature, and eroded states.
Responsive/motion: Recompose the field as rhythmic vertical bands on phones; camera movement is optional.
concepts.spark: Black columns descend toward surf in impossible regularity, each top catching a different sheet of rain.
concepts.webLeverage: Instanced hexagonal prisms and fracture growth simulate column formation efficiently.

concepts.form: a limestone cave growing drop by drop, with branching chambers, mineral curtains, and climate history sealed inside formations
concepts.lineage: speleology, cave lighting, and natural-history interpretation; grounded in geological field craft, mineral collections, scientific illustration, and immersive earth-history exhibitions
system: Palette/material: absolute cave dark as ground, lamplit calcite amber and flowstone cream, rust-orange growth bands, the live drip glinting as the accent
Type/composition: warm lantern serif in pooled islands of light, captions surfacing only inside the lit chambers while the dark field stays unlettered
Topology/navigation: Navigate entrance, chamber, formation, growth band, and source water path.
Controls/state: Scrub centuries, change rainfall, and show dripping, accreting, dormant, and broken states.
Responsive/motion: Turn cave branches into a chamber sequence on phones; growth is reversible and user-paced.
concepts.spark: A single drop lands in darkness; centuries race forward and a stone curtain slowly reaches the floor.
concepts.webLeverage: Signed-distance cave geometry and layered mineral growth animate geological time.

concepts.form: a rough geode split to reveal a crystalline interior cathedral, with radial growth, nested cavities, and light trapped between facets
concepts.lineage: mineral collection display and lapidary craft; grounded in geological field craft, mineral collections, scientific illustration, and immersive earth-history exhibitions
system: Palette/material: rough gray rind as ground, amethyst violet crystal points as the accent, quartz white facets between, the hollow center kept in shadowed black
Type/composition: lapidary specimen small caps with a locality line, labels growing radially from rim toward the hollow, facet edges ruling the columns
Topology/navigation: Navigate exterior shell, cut threshold, cavity, crystal family, and growth base.
Controls/state: Rotate, split, relight, and show closed, opening, revealed, and magnified states.
Responsive/motion: Use an interactive sectional cut on phones; sparkle never replaces readable contrast.
concepts.spark: An ordinary stone opens and floods the dark with thousands of violet points arranged around a hollow center.
concepts.webLeverage: PBR mineral shaders, parallax facets, and clipping planes reveal nested crystal structure.

concepts.form: a salt flat tiled by self-organizing polygons, with brine rising at edges, crystalline ridges, and mirage-softened distance
concepts.lineage: evaporite science, aerial land art, and desert optics; grounded in geological field craft, mineral collections, scientific illustration, and immersive earth-history exhibitions
system: Palette/material: blinding salt white ground with pale gray ridge shadows, deep umber body ink, mirror-cyan brine pools marking the active edges
Type/composition: sun-bleached thin caps with wide tracking, copy tiled to the hexagonal field, ridges serving as the only dividers between cells
Topology/navigation: Navigate aerial pattern, polygon edge, brine channel, crystal ridge, and horizon.
Controls/state: Change evaporation, flood depth, and show submerged, forming, mature, and dissolving states.
Responsive/motion: Shift between aerial field and single polygon on phones; mirage motion is restrained.
concepts.spark: White hexagons repeat beyond scale while shallow water turns the horizon into a perfect mirror.
concepts.webLeverage: Reaction-diffusion geometry and reflective shaders form evolving salt patterns.

concepts.form: a hydrothermal vent oasis in abyssal darkness, with mineral chimneys, black-smoker plumes, chemical gradients, and dense life around heat
concepts.lineage: deep-sea expedition imaging and chemosynthetic ecology; grounded in hydrological visualization, oceanographic expeditions, water-based installation, and landscape observation
system: Palette/material: abyssal black ground, chimney sulfide rust and ash gray, smoker plume charcoal against the dark, tube-worm crimson as the living accent
Type/composition: monospaced depth digits with small-cap specimen labels, copy held in lamplit circles of legibility surrounded by unbroken dark
Topology/navigation: Navigate abyssal plain, chimney, plume, gradient, and symbiotic community.
Controls/state: Shift chemistry, inspect species, and show dormant, venting, colonized, and collapsing states.
Responsive/motion: Use a chimney cross-section on phones; plume motion slows under
concepts.spark: A black plume erupts from a mineral tower and reveals a crowded white ecosystem in a world without sunlight.
concepts.webLeverage: Volume particles and reaction-gradient shaders reveal heat and chemistry around the vent.

concepts.form: a technical deep dive down a volcanic island wall, where one small diver leaves the turquoise surface, crosses a cold blue thermocline, and enters a mesophotic garden of black coral, glass sponges, and falling marine snow
concepts.lineage: Technical diving, oceanographic depth transects, mesophotic reef ecology, bathymetric profiles, and underwater documentary cinematography
system: Palette/material: abyssal ink blue deepening by dive stage as the ground, chalk-white marine snow as particle texture, one thermocline cyan band marking the active depth
Type/composition: monospaced dive-computer digits for depth and gas beside quiet grotesk notes, one vertical depth axis ruling every line of copy
Topology/navigation: Descend through surface, thermocline, reef ledge, mesophotic wall, turnaround depth, ascent stops, and the vertical route home.
Controls/state: Descend, hover, illuminate, mark, turn, and ascend with daylight, cooling, dark, gas-limited, decompression, and surfaced states.
Responsive/motion: Pair the vertical dive profile with selected close views; stop drift and bubbles under
concepts.spark: At forty meters the last warm red drains from the diver's gloves; a lamp clicks on, revealing black-coral branches and white particles falling past a wall with no visible floor.
concepts.webLeverage: A synchronized depth-and-time scrub can change light, color, sound, species, and ascent obligations together, while any observation remains pinned to its exact depth and dive phase.

concepts.form: a lapidary bench, rough stones becoming faceted gems against the wheel, dop sticks and index gears setting each cut angle, finished stones ranked in felt trays by cut and fire
concepts.lineage: lapidary craft, gem faceting diagrams, GIA cut nomenclature, mineralogy collection drawers
system: Palette/material: charcoal felt ground with steel bench tones, gems keep their true hues, tourmaline green to garnet red, the stone on the dop flashes fire as the active state
Type/composition: engraved small caps for stone names, cut angles and carat weights in tabular figures, facet diagrams drawn as fine ruled line art beside each tray
Topology/navigation: trays are collections sorted by cut and family; one stone lifts to the dop for work and the loupe view zooms until light paths become the map
Controls/state: adjustments turn the index gear in notched steps, each pass adds a facet you can count, progress reads as the rough going from frosted to fire
Responsive/motion: trays become a single scrolling drawer on small screens; motion is a slow gem rotation catching light
concepts.spark: you seat the dop against the lap and feel the stone take the wheel, frost giving way to a window, then tilt it under the loupe and watch the first facet fire a needle of red light across your knuckles
concepts.webLeverage: webgl refraction renders real light paths through facets, with svg facet diagrams and wheel-driven zoom as the fallback

concepts.form: a polished agate slice on a lapidary light table, concentric mineral bands ringing a druzy quartz pocket, every ring a sealed stratum of color readable from rough rind to hollow under one glassy face
concepts.lineage: Lapidary slab cutting and polishing, banded agate geology, mineral-show light-table display
system: Palette/material: smoke-gray rind as chrome, carnelian, honey and mist-blue bands as section grounds, white druzy sparkle reserved for focus, all sealed under one wet-polish gloss
Type/composition: lapidary specimen small caps with a locality line, headings seated on band boundaries, body copy on the widest calm band, columns ruled by the ring edges
Topology/navigation: concentric bands are the sections, overview at the rind and detail deepening inward, crossing a band boundary is the page transition
Controls/state: the light table is hover, glowing a band translucent from beneath; selection opens the druzy pocket wide, and unpolished matte marks what is disabled
Responsive/motion: bands unroll into stacked horizontal strata on phones, and motion is one slow light sweep across the polished face
concepts.spark: The lamp under the glass clicks on and the slice ignites, honey and carnelian rings glowing around a pocket of white crystal teeth, and you trace the stone's whole life from rough rind to hollow with one fingertip.
concepts.webLeverage: Radial gradients and svg ring paths make each band a clickable region while backdrop-filter carries the backlit translucency.

families.label: Living Worlds
families.description: Plants, animals, ecologies, collective behavior, growth, adaptation, and the strange architectures of life.

concepts.form: a tokonoma alcove holding an ikebana arrangement of one weathered pine branch, three irises, and an off-center bronze suiban, where line, asymmetry, season, and ma make the surrounding emptiness active
concepts.lineage: Japanese ikebana practice, moribana composition, tokonoma display, and attentive use of seasonal plant material
system: Palette/material: pale plaster alcove as ground, weathered gray-brown pine for body, three iris-blue stems marking the active accent, a dark bronze suiban at the base
Type/composition: a few vertical characters set off-center, primary secondary and supporting lines forming an asymmetric triangle, empty plaster left charged as ma
Topology/navigation: Move among primary, secondary, and supporting lines while vessel, viewing front, seasonal material, and active emptiness remain related.
Controls/state: Trim, angle, rotate, place, and remove stems with budding, open, balanced, crowded, fading, and renewed states.
Responsive/motion: Preserve the arrangement's viewing front and proportional emptiness on small screens; use plan and elevation views instead of decorative reflow.
concepts.spark: One pine branch rises through the quiet alcove, bends toward three blue irises, and leaves a charged triangle of empty plaster more vivid than another flower could fill.
concepts.webLeverage: Direct manipulation can preserve stem-angle, balance, and negative-space constraints, while a time scrub connects each plant's seasonal and fading state to the whole composition.

concepts.form: a cephalopod skin becoming a living display, with expanding chromatophores, traveling patterns, texture change, and context-dependent signals
concepts.lineage: cephalopod behavior research and responsive-material design; grounded in marine natural history, night diving, fluorescence imaging, and immersive bioluminescent art
system: Palette/material: pale mantle-cream as ground, red-brown chromatophores as body ink, one iridophore blue-green flash marking the active signal, dark ridges as texture
Type/composition: a variable typeface whose weight tracks pigment expansion, patterns traveling body to skin-cell as waves, signals drawn directly onto the surface
Topology/navigation: Navigate whole body, skin region, pigment cell, pattern wave, and environmental trigger.
Controls/state: Change context, draw signals, and show neutral, camouflaging, warning, and communicating states.
Responsive/motion: Flatten skin into an inspectable living textile on phones; pattern speed is adjustable.
concepts.spark: A pale animal crosses patterned stone and its skin becomes waves, eyes, and ridges in less than a heartbeat.
concepts.webLeverage: GPU cellular shaders and displacement textures render signal, color, and texture together.

concepts.form: a night sea igniting with bioluminescent plankton, with every wake tracing motion, fading memory, and currents revealed by living light
concepts.lineage: marine bioluminescence and long-exposure night photography; grounded in marine natural history, night diving, fluorescence imaging, and immersive bioluminescent art
system: Palette/material: black night sea as ground, electric-blue plankton light marking the active wake, cyan fading traces as body, darkness reclaiming everything at rest
Type/composition: thin luminous letterforms glowing on black, wayfinding drawn as pointer trails across a dark field, text held bright enough to read over the void
Topology/navigation: Navigate dark field, disturbance path, glowing eddy, fade history, and current direction.
Controls/state: Draw wakes, change speed, and show dormant, excited, radiant, and fading states.
Responsive/motion: Use touch trails on phones
concepts.spark: A hand enters black water and draws a blue galaxy that survives for seconds before darkness closes.
concepts.webLeverage: GPU particles react to pointer velocity and advect through a visible current field.

concepts.form: a printed phylogenetic wall chart in the haeckel tradition, branching ink lines rising from a single root, clade labels ranked along each limb, extinct branches ending in small daggers, deep-time rings scaled outward like tree growth
concepts.lineage: Ernst Haeckel's tree engravings, Darwin's branching notebook sketch, Hillis circular cladograms, and engraved natural-history wall charts
system: Palette/material: aged paper-cream ground, sepia-black ink for the branching lines, one vermilion dagger marking each extinct tip, faint gray rings scaling deep time
Type/composition: engraved small-caps clade labels ranked along each limb, a branching grid rooted at one origin, hairline connectors thickening toward the trunk
Topology/navigation: zoom from kingdom to single organism along the branching spine, ancestry as the fixed path, extinct limbs kept as quiet negative space
Controls/state: toggle trait overlays, confidence ranges, and alternate trees; nodes read as living, extinct, disputed, or uncertain
Responsive/motion: prune labels by scale so only the visited rank stays legible, the selected lineage held across layouts
concepts.spark: You stand before a wall of aged chart paper; sepia ink branches climb from one root past ranked small-caps names, your finger traces a limb outward through widening time rings until it ends at a single vermilion dagger where a lineage went extinct.
concepts.webLeverage: Semantic zoom over an SVG cladogram keeps ancestry fixed while labels prune by scale, and view transitions carry the selected lineage smoothly across radial and vertical layouts.

concepts.form: a survey plate of a single tide pool sampled through a day, the same quadrat photographed at five states of water with species keyed by number, and a ruled abundance table beneath recording what appeared and what withdrew
concepts.lineage: ecological quadrat survey plates, repeated-sample photography with numbered species keys and abundance tabulation
system: Palette/material: cool wet stone and weed greens photographed evenly, with numbered key markers in one high-contrast color placed physically in frame
Type/composition: five samples of the identical quadrat ranged in a row, numbered species keys overlaid, and a ruled abundance table beneath
Topology/navigation: the frame never moves so change is the only variable, and navigation compares states of one fixed view
Controls/state: controls are species keys, the active one highlights every occurrence across all five samples, and absent ones gray in the table
Responsive/motion: samples stack while staying aligned to the same quadrat bounds, and motion is a cross-fade between water states
concepts.spark: The same square of rock five times in one day, and the numbers tell you exactly what came out and what went back under while the water moved.
concepts.webLeverage: aligned sample cross-fade at fixed bounds, species key state highlighting across all samples, and a linked abundance table

families.label: Light & Hidden Forces
families.description: Light, shadow, flow, turbulence, fields, electricity, magnetism, and matter made perceptible through consequence.

concepts.form: a cityscape passing from blue hour into rain-dark night, where skyline silhouette, window grids, transit veins, rooftop beacons, wet streets, river reflections, and first dawn light form an urban nocturne
concepts.lineage: Night photography, urban-light masterplanning, nocturne painting, neon and sign craft, location cinematography, and public-realm lighting design
system: Palette/material: cobalt blue-hour over black towers as ground, amber transit and neon signs as body, one silver dawn facade marking the hour, wet streets doubling each light
Type/composition: neon-sign lettering against condensed dark type, skyline street and reflection stacked as synchronized night bands, transit veins timed along the axis
Topology/navigation: Move between skyline, street canyon, transit line, rooftop signal, river mirror, public landmark, weather layer, and chosen viewpoint.
Controls/state: Shift hour and weather, follow one public light journey, and compare blue-hour, active, rain-bright, dimmed, blackout, and dawn states.
Responsive/motion: Unroll skyline, street, and reflection into synchronized night bands on phones
concepts.spark: The last cobalt sky drains behind black towers; trains draw amber stitches across the river, rain doubles every sign on the street, and one eastern facade turns silver before dawn.
concepts.webLeverage: Time-indexed transit, weather, and civic-light data, spatial Web Audio, deep-linked viewpoints, and a semantic city index let users read collective nocturnal rhythm without exposing private households.

concepts.form: a hand-bent neon letter becoming a continuous gas-discharge circuit, where glass radius, electrode placement, gas, pressure, transformer load, and typography determine the final light
concepts.lineage: neon sign bending, urban lettering, glass tube craft, gas-discharge spectroscopy, electrical fabrication, and sign-conservation practice
system: Palette/material: dark room as ground, clear glass tube softening over flame, one cobalt gas-discharge glow marking the active run, warm electrode-red at the sealed ends
Type/composition: hand-bent script drawn as one continuous glass stroke, glyphs bending on a fabrication path, bridges and electrodes ranked where the circuit breaks
Topology/navigation: Follow glyph, tube run, bend, bridge, electrode, transformer circuit, gas spectrum, and installed sign.
Controls/state: Edit path, change gas, test bend radius, split circuits, and compare sketched, bent, pumped, aging, and restored states.
Responsive/motion: Unroll the tube into a fabrication path on phones
concepts.spark: A clear glass stroke softens over flame and bends into a cobalt script; electrodes seal, the room goes dark, and one continuous word ignites from within.
concepts.webLeverage: Direct SVG path editing, bend-radius and transformer validation, selectable source text, spectral comparison, and fabrication-ready export turn browser typography into a buildable neon circuit.

concepts.form: a reel of magnetic tape carrying an audible memory landscape, where oxide domains, splices, erasure, saturation, and repeated playback reshape recorded time
concepts.lineage: analog tape recording, musique concrete, broadcast editing craft, magnetic-domain science, and archival audio conservation
system: Palette/material: rust-brown oxide tape as ground, a lit table glowing beneath it, silver splice tape marking the active edit, darkened saturation scars as body ink
Type/composition: grease-pencil reel labels and timecode along a linear strip, passages spliced end to end, erased gaps and saturation scars marked in the running order
Topology/navigation: Travel by reel, recorded passage, splice, erased gap, saturation scar, and assembled sequence.
Controls/state: Scrub, cut, join, reverse, overdub, and compare source, marked, spliced, degraded, and restored states.
Responsive/motion: Unroll the reel into an addressable passage strip on phones
concepts.spark: Rust-brown tape unwinds across a light table; touching one darkened span releases a lost voice, while a silver splice turns its final word into a new beginning.
concepts.webLeverage: Web Audio scrubbing, non-destructive edit history in IndexedDB, and shareable time-range URLs let users hear, rearrange, and preserve magnetic recordings without flattening provenance.

concepts.form: a skyspace chamber, a knife-edge ceiling aperture framing open sky as the single color field, stone benches ringing bare plaster walls tuned by slow dusk light programs
concepts.lineage: James Turrell skyspaces, Roden Crater, the Light and Space movement
system: Palette/material: bare plaster warmed to ember by the wash, the aperture's sky a live cyan-to-violet field as the active surface, graphite shadow for body ink
Type/composition: one hairline sans line letter-spaced wide at the threshold, otherwise near wordless, a centered void ringed by an even bench margin
Topology/navigation: one chamber, one ceiling opening; all wayfinding is orientation toward the aperture, secondary items ring the walls at even bench spacing
Controls/state: the light program is the state, choosing a step rewashes the whole room's hue so the framed sky seems to change color, nothing takes an outline
Responsive/motion: the aperture letterboxes to a narrow slot on small screens; motion is hue drift too slow to catch
concepts.spark: You step down onto a cool stone bench as the program begins; the plaster walls warm to ember and the square of open sky overhead turns an impossible green, then violet, and someone across the chamber exhales.
concepts.webLeverage: css transitions running minute-long hue interpolation on one background layer, mix-blend-mode tinting the framed sky region

concepts.form: an indoor weather sun, a monofrequency semicircle doubled to a full disc by a mirrored ceiling, mist haze filling a vast hall where crowds lie inside their own silhouettes
concepts.lineage: Olafur Eliasson's The Weather Project, Tate Turbine Hall, Light and Space lineage
system: Palette/material: monofrequency sodium amber flattening every color, hazed amber as ground, silhouette black for body ink, the mirror's doubled sun as the accent
Type/composition: silhouette-black grotesk set low against a long horizon line, one vast horizontal band, captions small and scattered like lying figures
Topology/navigation: one hall with a half sun at its far wall, the mirrored ceiling doubling everything; you navigate by walking the long axis toward the light
Controls/state: your pointer is a silhouette, hover deepens a figure to full black, selection appears twice, once on the floor and once in the ceiling mirror
Responsive/motion: the semicircle scales with the wall and its mirror half collapses first on short screens; motion is drifting mist
concepts.spark: You lie on the concrete floor of a vast hall, haze thick with amber; far above, the mirrored ceiling shows your tiny silhouette waving back beside a hundred strangers, and the half sun on the wall completes itself into a disc.
concepts.webLeverage: backdrop-filter haze over a css scaleY(-1) reflection building the mirrored ceiling, blend mode flattening all color to amber duotone

concepts.form: a black-hole accretion disk at the edge of disappearance, with warped horizons, time-dilated rings, and matter crossing an irreversible threshold
concepts.lineage: relativistic visualization and cinematic scientific simulation; grounded in deep-field astronomy, planetarium-scale science visualization, and immersive cosmic media
system: Palette/material: void black ground, disk light graded blue-white toward approach and ember red in recession, a photon-ring gold arc as the active accent
Type/composition: hairline technical grotesk with lining numerals bent along concentric ring bands, labels orbiting the rim, the center held as unmarked black
Topology/navigation: Navigate outer disk, photon ring, horizon, and observer viewpoints through guided anchors.
Controls/state: Change viewpoint, trace matter, and show orbiting, plunging, redshifted, and lost states.
Responsive/motion: Replace free orbit with sectional viewpoints on phones
concepts.spark: A bright disk folds over itself while one glowing fragment slows, reddens, and vanishes at the horizon.
concepts.webLeverage: Relativistic shader approximation bends light and color around an interactive horizon.

families.label: Patterns & Motion
families.description: Kinetic sculpture, physical causality, procedural art, rule-driven emergence, and authored systems that visibly transform.

concepts.form: a hand-cranked paper menagerie of tabs, bellows, and pinned joints, where humble folds produce a surprising procession of motion
concepts.lineage: Paper automata, movable books, and hand-cut mechanical toys
system: Palette/material: cut white paper on kraft board as the ground, charcoal cast shadow as body ink, one crimson fold reserved for the figure currently in motion
Type/composition: hand-cut letterpress caps with visible tab and slot marks, captions on folded paper strips beneath each figure, one crank line ruling the base
Topology/navigation: Advance through a procession while each figure opens into its own linkage and supporting details.
Controls/state: Turn, pause, reverse, and inspect joints with folded, tensioned, extended, and resting states.
Responsive/motion: Reduce the procession to one figure per viewport and provide illustrated keyframes beside every control.
concepts.spark: The crank turns; a white fox bows, a crimson bird opens concertina wings, and their shadows cross on the paper wall behind them.
concepts.webLeverage: Pointer and keyboard input can drive a common crank timeline, synchronizing SVG cut-paper layers with accessible step descriptions.

concepts.form: a monumental escapement clock paced by a silver tidal dial, where energy advances through teeth, pallets, and lunar intervals
concepts.lineage: Marine chronometers, astronomical clocks, and exposed escapement craft
system: Palette/material: silvered dial ground with engraved black chapter figures as body ink, brass wheelwork behind, moon-white reserved for the advancing hand
Type/composition: engraved roman chapter numerals and small caps on concentric rings, text follows the circle, intervals ruled by tick marks not boxes
Topology/navigation: Traverse long cycles through nested lunar, tidal, daily, and momentary scales.
Controls/state: Wind, pause, advance, and compare intervals while stored, released, and depleted energy stays explicit.
Responsive/motion: Stack the time scales into concentric readouts and replace ticking with user-stepped advances when requested.
concepts.spark: A polished wheel strains against its pallet, releases one tooth with a dry click, and a moon-white tide hand advances almost imperceptibly.
concepts.webLeverage: Deterministic time simulation can couple astronomical cycles to an inspectable mechanical chain without blocking the page shell.

concepts.form: a tensegrity column of carbon rods and red cord, where opposing forces make a rigid body appear to inhale and lengthen
concepts.lineage: Tensegrity research, deployable structures, and kinetic spatial sculpture
system: Palette/material: matte carbon-black rods on a pale concrete ground, red cord as the tension accent, slack members dropping to ash gray
Type/composition: engineering monospaced labels with force values, annotations pinned to nodes on leader lines, layout obeys the strut network not a page grid
Topology/navigation: Expose a network of tension and compression paths, letting users trace any load to its counterforce.
Controls/state: Pull, release, lock, and compare members while slack, balanced, stressed, and failed states are distinct.
Responsive/motion: Flatten the column into a force diagram on compact screens and substitute before-after poses for continuous breathing.
concepts.spark: The cords tighten in sequence; black rods float apart without touching, and the column rises as if drawing a slow breath.
concepts.webLeverage: A constraint graph can drive both spatial geometry and a semantic force diagram from the same underlying state.

concepts.form: a mirrored infinity room of polka dots, dotted pumpkins and paper lanterns multiplied past counting, one dot motif carried from button scale to cosmos scale
concepts.lineage: Yayoi Kusama infinity mirror rooms, obliteration dots, the Naoshima pumpkin
system: Palette/material: mirror black depth as ground, cadmium yellow pumpkin skins carrying black dots, red-on-white dot cards, the lit lantern dot as the active state
Type/composition: chunky rounded grotesk in dot red on white, the dot grid the only layout law, every element aligned to dot centers from button to banner
Topology/navigation: one small room reflected past counting; depth is navigation, stepping toward a reflection opens it one recursion deeper
Controls/state: every control is a dot, toggles fill from ring to solid, the selected dot swells one scale step while the infinite field holds its rhythm
Responsive/motion: the dot motif is scale free, so the grid re-tiles at any width without breaking; motion is a slow lantern pulse
concepts.spark: You stand on a low platform between mirrored walls; red-dotted pumpkins repeat toward a horizon that keeps receding, your reflection multiplies into a crowd, and every surface, even your hands, carries the same dots.
concepts.webLeverage: canvas tiling one dot sprite into false mirror depth, css radial-gradient dot fields re-tiling responsively at every scale

concepts.form: an endless column, one gilded rhomboid module stacked skyward until repetition reads as ascent, cast iron under open weather on a flat plain
concepts.lineage: Constantin Brancusi's Endless Column, the Targu Jiu ensemble, modernist seriality
system: Palette/material: gilded brass ochre modules against a flat zinc gray sky, cast iron near black for body ink, the active module alone taking the fresh gold finish
Type/composition: one geometric modernist sans stacked in equal-height modules, the vertical rhythm absolute, every block the same measure and no ragged sizes
Topology/navigation: a single vertical axis; items stack as identical rhomboid modules and wayfinding is counting your height up the column
Controls/state: state never changes a module's size, only its finish, gilded for active, weathered dull for rest, the seam between modules the only divider
Responsive/motion: the column stays one column at every width, modules just tighten; motion is a stepwise rise, one module per beat
concepts.spark: You crane your neck at the base of the column; identical gilded rhomboids climb into a flat gray sky until you lose count, wind pushes cold across the plain, and the top module dissolves into glare.
concepts.webLeverage: css scroll-snap stepping the viewport one module per snap point, scroll-linked animation making ascent a counted rhythm

families.label: Craft & Making
families.description: Glass, metal, clay, heat, pressure, fracture, repair, patina, and the expressive behavior of matter under skilled hands.

concepts.form: a celadon bowl whose pale green glaze opens into deep ice-like crackle, where cooling stress writes a second geometry over the vessel
concepts.lineage: East Asian celadon traditions, crackle glaze chemistry, and kiln cooling practice
system: Palette/material: pale celadon green glaze as the ground, iron-dark crackle lines as body ink, freshly stained cracks flashing amber for the active branch
Type/composition: brush-fine hairline serifs echoing crack weight, sparse labels floating in open glaze fields, layout follows crack junctions not a grid
Topology/navigation: Move between whole vessel, crack network, junction, and local glaze depth while position stays registered.
Controls/state: Cool, stain, trace, and compare with molten, sealed, initiating, opened, and aged states.
Responsive/motion: Replace live propagation with a labeled sequence of crack maps and preserve a complete branch list.
concepts.spark: The bowl leaves the kiln luminous and still; over the next hour a fine dark crack races through the green glaze with an audible ping.
concepts.webLeverage: Progressive fracture geometry can tie each branch to cooling time and glaze thickness without requiring constant motion.

concepts.form: a monumental earthen tower built from visible coils, where compression, drying, and hand pressure leave a slow ascending record
concepts.lineage: Coil-built ceramics, vernacular earthen construction, and large-scale clay sculpture
system: Palette/material: raw terracotta and umber coil bands as the ground, slip-white seams as dividers, one damp dark clay ring marking the course in progress
Type/composition: broad low-contrast slab caps like stamped brick marks, text banded in horizontal courses, each line's measure matching its coil
Topology/navigation: Rise through courses while local joins, wall thickness, and overall silhouette remain connected.
Controls/state: Add, compress, brace, dry, and inspect with plastic, bearing, cracking, leather-hard, and fired states.
Responsive/motion: Convert the tower into an ordered vertical section and show construction growth only on request.
concepts.spark: Broad clay ropes circle upward above the maker's head, each thumb-smoothed seam catching a different band of late light.
concepts.webLeverage: Incremental geometry can connect each course to time, maker action, and structural consequence without large assets.

concepts.form: a kiln shelf beneath a row of heavily glazed cups, where molten color pools, runs, stops, and sometimes welds the vessel to the floor
concepts.lineage: High-fire glaze testing, kiln furniture, and flux behavior
system: Palette/material: chalk-white kiln shelf as the ground, cobalt glaze runs as the accent flow, fused puddles hardening to glassy sapphire for the warning state
Type/composition: monospaced batch numerals on recipe cards beside each cup, samples ranked in one shelf row, gravity setting the vertical reading order
Topology/navigation: Connect recipe, thickness, kiln position, vertical path, and final pool for each sample.
Controls/state: Apply, fire, flow, arrest, and compare with dry, melting, running, pooled, and fused states.
