Responsive/motion: Replace molten flow with registered stage overlays and keep recipe and risk visible beside every sample.
concepts.spark: A cobalt glaze reaches the foot in one thick tear, freezes a millimeter above the shelf, while the cup beside it spills into a glassy blue puddle.
concepts.webLeverage: A viscosity-and-slope model can predict meaningful thresholds while remaining bounded to selected samples.

concepts.form: a paper-thin porcelain lantern turned almost transparent by fire, where carved thickness controls which veins of warm light survive
concepts.lineage: Translucent porcelain, lithophane carving, and ceramic lighting
system: Palette/material: unglazed porcelain white as the ground, carved veins glowing candle-amber where light passes, overcut zones warning in hot orange
Type/composition: hairline didone with carved-thin strokes, labels surfacing under backlight like lithophane imagery, layout ruled by the vessel's rotation bands
Topology/navigation: Pair outer form, thickness map, and transmitted image so hidden structure remains locatable.
Controls/state: Carve, illuminate, rotate, and compare with opaque, thinning, translucent, and overcut states.
Responsive/motion: Use synchronized exterior and light-through views on small screens and retain high-contrast relief diagrams.
concepts.spark: Unlit, the vessel is quiet white; the flame inside reveals a hidden forest of branches carved only a millimeter beneath the skin.
concepts.webLeverage: Thickness-aware rendering can reveal hidden imagery while the same scalar map drives accessible contours and labels.

concepts.form: a red-hot raku vessel lifted into smoke and combustible leaves, where thermal shock, carbon, and exposed clay create an unrehearsed black-white skin
concepts.lineage: Japanese raku firing and contemporary post-firing reduction practice
system: Palette/material: soot-black carbonized clay as the ground, crackled silver-white glaze as the body surface, ember orange reserved for the still-hot active vessel
Type/composition: rough brush-stroke marks paired with a quiet grotesk for data, stage labels stacked like kiln logs, asymmetry accepted as the compositional law
Topology/navigation: Follow vessel regions through glaze coverage, smoke contact, reduction, and crack response.
Controls/state: Fire, expose, cover, cool, and reveal with hot, reducing, carbonized, cracked, and cleaned states.
Responsive/motion: Present the firing as deliberate stages and provide still material maps for every result.
concepts.spark: Tongs lift the orange bowl into a bed of leaves; smoke folds over it, and when the lid opens the glaze shines silver against soot-black clay.
concepts.webLeverage: A probabilistic surface process can make conditions consequential while preserving exact input and outcome records.

concepts.form: a pale ceramic jar fired inside a sealed saggar with salts, wire, and seaweed, where vapor and contact leave rust-red weather across the surface
concepts.lineage: Saggar firing, vapor marking, and atmospheric ceramic surfaces
system: Palette/material: cream jar body as the ground, smoke-gray vapor drift as the secondary tone, one vermilion contact halo marking the selected mark
Type/composition: field-notebook italic annotations tied to each mark, a flat gridded placement diagram beside the vessel, letters kept off the surface itself
Topology/navigation: Read the final surface through placement, contact, vapor path, and firing zone.
Controls/state: Arrange, seal, fire, unwrap, and compare with packed, vaporizing, marked, cooled, and revealed states.
Responsive/motion: Pair a flat placement diagram with the finished vessel and avoid simulated fire when static evidence suffices.
concepts.spark: The jar emerges cream and smoke-gray, crossed by one vermilion halo where copper wire touched it in the dark kiln.
concepts.webLeverage: Registered before-after maps can connect hidden material placement to final atmospheric marks.

concepts.form: a leaded rose window of mouth-blown glass and dark structural cames, where radial stories are held together by visible joints
concepts.lineage: Gothic rose windows, stained-glass painting, and lead-came construction
system: Palette/material: matte black lead cames as the structural ink, cobalt blue and ruby red pot-metal fields, clear star glass as the ground where light reads white
Type/composition: lombardic display capitals with a plain roman for captions, chapters ranked by radial ring, every text block bounded by a visible came
Topology/navigation: Use radial hierarchy for chapters while lead joints expose relation, boundary, and return paths.
Controls/state: Open, isolate, compare, and trace segments with clear, colored, repaired, and missing states that do not rely on hue alone.
Responsive/motion: Recast radial sectors into an ordered chapter wheel and offer a high-contrast line-art mode.
concepts.spark: Blue saints, red leaves, and clear stars orbit a black iron center while late sun paints their geometry across the opposite wall.
concepts.webLeverage: Vector geometry can support deep radial navigation, precise zoom, and accessible segment descriptions from one structure.

concepts.form: a cut millefiori cane revealing hundreds of miniature colored flowers, where one long composite rod contains the same intricate world at every slice
concepts.lineage: Venetian millefiori glassmaking and composite cane construction
system: Palette/material: dark uncut cane skin as the ground, cobalt hexagon fields with daisy-white cores inside, the freshly cut slice polished bright as the active face
Type/composition: tiny repeated cap labels like cane stamps, content tiled in a packed hexagonal lattice, one enlarged slice serving as the master legend
Topology/navigation: Move between whole cane, nested component, and repeated slice while preserving the part-to-whole relation.
Controls/state: Slice, rotate, isolate, and compare components with bundled, fused, cut, and polished states.
Responsive/motion: Turn spatial slicing into a stepped cross-section sequence and pair color with labeled geometry.
concepts.spark: A plain dark rod meets the saw; its polished cut opens into a field of tiny white daisies nested inside cobalt hexagons.
concepts.webLeverage: Procedural cross-sections can expose deeply nested composition without loading a unique asset for every slice.

concepts.form: a long stone nave crossed by suspended prisms, where daylight breaks into moving caustics that mark passage, emphasis, and time
concepts.lineage: Architectural daylight studies, optical prisms, and sacred spatial proportion
system: Palette/material: cool limestone gray as the ground, deep nave shadow as the resting tone, split spectral bands from violet to red reserved for the active pool
Type/composition: incised lapidary capitals at fixed landmarks, wayfinding text set along the processional axis, spectral labels stacked in prism order
Topology/navigation: Organize the route by successive pools of refracted light while architectural landmarks remain stable.
Controls/state: Rotate, focus, and compare prisms with direct, split, scattered, and shadowed light states.
Responsive/motion: Convert the nave into a linear sequence on small screens and freeze caustics into labeled spectral bands.
concepts.spark: At noon a blade of white sun enters the dark nave, strikes a hanging prism, and lays a trembling spectrum across the floor from door to altar.
concepts.webLeverage: Physically based light transport can make orientation and time visible while a semantic route remains primary.

concepts.form: a white-hot iron bar drawn under a power hammer, where each blow sends black scale outward and lengthens the metal with brutal clarity
concepts.lineage: Open-die forging, blacksmithing, and industrial hammer craft
system: Palette/material: forge-dark ground with anvil-gray steel, the workpiece graded from black through cherry to white heat, scale flecks as black particle texture
Type/composition: heavy stenciled industrial caps with tabular force numerals, one blow per full-width row, measurements ruled like a smith's chalk marks
Topology/navigation: Move through heats and blows while cross-section, length, and force remain registered.
Controls/state: Heat, strike, rotate, and measure with cold, forging-hot, scaling, distorted, and normalized states.
Responsive/motion: Present one blow per deliberate step and replace impact animation with before-after geometry and force values.
concepts.spark: The hammer falls; a halo of black scale leaps from orange iron, and the square billet becomes visibly longer in a single strike.
concepts.webLeverage: Fast local deformation and particle shedding can be bounded to user-triggered moments while measured state stays in the DOM.

concepts.form: a copper vessel raised from one flat disc by thousands of overlapping hammer blows, where geometry emerges as a field of small decisions
concepts.lineage: Metalsmith raising, planishing, and hand-hammered hollowware
system: Palette/material: rose and salmon planished copper as the ground, annealed oxide purple for softened zones, one bright struck facet as the active mark
Type/composition: small caps stamped in concentric rings echoing hammer courses, captions curving with the raising rows, radial symmetry as the layout law
Topology/navigation: Move through concentric raising courses while any local mark remains connected to the evolving whole form.
Controls/state: Strike, anneal, planish, and compare with work-hardened, softened, rough, and finished states.
Responsive/motion: Flatten the vessel into course diagrams on small screens and preserve marks as addressable evidence.
concepts.spark: A flat red disc turns slowly over the stake; rings of hammer marks climb inward until a deep bowl stands where no seam exists.
concepts.webLeverage: A deformation history can drive both a spatial vessel and a precise map of accumulated local actions.

concepts.form: a lost-wax bronze shell emerging from a shattered investment mold, where the absent wax survives as metal, gates, and cooled seams
concepts.lineage: Lost-wax casting, bronze sculpture, and foundry gating craft
system: Palette/material: chalk-white investment as the ground, dark oil-brown bronze as body ink, sprue channels and hot joints glowing pour-orange for active flow
Type/composition: foundry stencil caps with fine chased engraving for detail labels, stages ordered as a strict casting sequence, callouts pinned to gates
Topology/navigation: Follow form from wax through channels, void, pour, shell, and final bronze with transformations explicit.
Controls/state: Gate, vent, pour, cool, and finish with wax, invested, molten, cast, and chased states.
Responsive/motion: Use a staged material sequence on phones and provide section diagrams for hidden flow paths.
concepts.spark: The chalk-white mold breaks away in chunks, revealing a dark bronze figure still webbed with sprues and glowing faintly at the thickest joints.
concepts.webLeverage: A shared volume model can reveal positive form, negative mold, and metal flow as alternate but registered states.

concepts.form: a mokume-gane laminate carved and forged into wood-grain metal, where dissimilar alloys flow into knots, eyes, and wandering strata
concepts.lineage: Japanese mokume-gane laminated-metal craft
system: Palette/material: copper, silver, and blue-black shakudo strata as the working surfaces, etched silver contour lines as body ink, one bright knot as the selected eye
Type/composition: fine engraved italic labels following the grain contours, layer order listed in a strict stacked ledger, no straight rules crossing the flow
Topology/navigation: Trace visible grain through stacked alloys, carved depressions, and subsequent deformation.
Controls/state: Stack, bond, carve, forge, and etch with separate, fused, exposed, stretched, and finished states.
Responsive/motion: Show synchronized layer and surface diagrams on compact screens and avoid decorative animation.
concepts.spark: Copper, silver, and dark shakudo emerge from the etch as a metallic burl, with one bright knot folding back into itself.
concepts.webLeverage: Procedural laminate geometry can reveal the causal link between hidden layer order and final surface grain.

concepts.form: a repoussé copper sun pushed outward from the reverse and chased from the face, where relief is negotiated between unseen pressure and visible line
concepts.lineage: Repoussé, chasing, and architectural metal ornament
system: Palette/material: burnished copper-gold relief as the ground, chased shadow lines as ink, the ray under the tool warming to rose-gold for the active state
Type/composition: chased Roman capitals following the ray lines, front and reverse views ruled as mirrored panels, hierarchy carried by relief depth not weight
Topology/navigation: Pair front and reverse views so every visible ridge can be traced to its hidden source pressure.
Controls/state: Raise, sink, chase, and compare with flat, roughed, defined, and finished regions.
Responsive/motion: Switch between synchronized front and reverse maps on compact screens and retain a tactile relief description.
concepts.spark: From the back, blunt tools raise a copper dome; turned over, fine chasing cuts rays until the metal catches light as a fierce golden sun.
concepts.webLeverage: Linked height maps can keep two-sided editing and inspection synchronized without requiring a heavy solid model.

concepts.form: a polished steel ribbon heated from one end, where pale straw, violet, and blue advance as a visible map of temperature
concepts.lineage: Steel tempering, heat-color observation, and toolmaking
system: Palette/material: polished silver steel as the ground, temper bands running straw to violet to cobalt as state colors, quenched zones fixed in matte gray
Type/composition: instrument-grade monospaced numerals ranked beneath the ribbon, one continuous horizontal band as the layout spine, labels tick at each hue shift
Topology/navigation: Read the ribbon as a continuous gradient tied to exact position, temperature, and material response.
Controls/state: Heat, hold, quench, and compare with cold, oxidizing, tempered, overheated, and quenched states.
Responsive/motion: Offer discrete temperature bands with labels and patterns so color never carries meaning alone.
concepts.spark: A faint straw line appears on silver steel, deepens through purple, and races as cobalt toward the quenched edge.
concepts.webLeverage: A compact thermal model can couple time, temperature, and material color with accessible numeric readouts.

concepts.form: a talavera courtyard, tin-glazed hand-painted tiles in cobalt, yellow, and green climbing stair risers and fountain walls, each tile imperfect alone, ordered as an ensemble
concepts.lineage: Puebla Talavera poblana workshops, Spanish-Moorish azulejo inheritance, Uriarte Talavera, Mexican courtyard architecture
system: Palette/material: cobalt on milk-white tin glaze as the base pair, sun yellow and leaf green as secondary marks, terracotta grout lines as the ground between modules
Type/composition: lettering hand-brushed inside single tiles like house numbers, layout locked to the tile module, patterns quartered so four corners complete a motif
Topology/navigation: the courtyard reads wall by wall; stair risers form a numbered vertical sequence and each landing is a section framed in its own tile border
Controls/state: the active tile brightens its glaze with a wet specular sheen, pressed tiles show brush imperfections up close, borders mark editable regions
Responsive/motion: the module never stretches, columns of tiles drop instead; motion is a glaze glint passing on hover
concepts.spark: You climb a Puebla staircase where every riser is a different painted tile, cobalt ferns and yellow suns wobbling slightly from tile to tile, your hand on a cool glazed rail, a fountain repeating the same blue below.
concepts.webLeverage: css grid enforces the tile module and a specular gradient animation plays the glaze glint on the active cell

concepts.form: a leaded-glass domestic interior, Tiffany lamps and Prairie-style geometric windows throwing colored light across plaster and oak, panels of came-bound glass composing every surface
concepts.lineage: Tiffany Studios, Frank Lloyd Wright art glass, contemporary architectural leaded glass
system: Palette/material: warm plaster and oak ground, opalescent amber, sage and cream glass, lead came as the dark line ink, one ruby pane marking the active panel
Type/composition: geometric Prairie capitals with wide tracking, text held in rectilinear came-bound panels, the layout ruled by lead lines rather than boxes
Topology/navigation: rooms are lit by their windows; sections are panels in one glazed wall and moving through them follows the daylight from pane to pane
Controls/state: hover warms a pane as if the sun found it, selection sets its cast-light patch on the floor, disabled panes go to unlit slate gray
Responsive/motion: panels stack into one tall glazed column on phones with came lines intact; motion is slow cast light drifting across the floor
concepts.spark: you read in the window seat as the afternoon moves, the sage and amber lattice sliding across your page, and when a cloud passes the whole oak floor dims and relights like the room breathing
concepts.webLeverage: css blend modes and conic gradients do glass luminosity, svg draws the came lattice, a slow animation drifts the cast light

concepts.form: a copper lantern souk at night, pierced and hammered lamps hung lit in constellations, each throwing its punched pattern as shadow lace across walls, stalls and passersby
concepts.lineage: Moroccan and Egyptian pierced metalwork, Marrakesh medina lamp workshops, mashrabiya light craft
system: Palette/material: deep night-blue alley ground, hammered copper and brass lamp bodies, candle amber as the light ink, the chosen lantern glowing hottest as the active state
Type/composition: geometric arabesque display forms over a plain humanist body face, content composed as lit lanterns against dark, captions riding the shadow lace
Topology/navigation: the alley is a hung field; lanterns cluster by workshop, you walk deeper stall by stall and each lamp opens to show the pattern that made its shadow
Controls/state: brushing a lantern makes it sway and its shadow lace swings with it, selection brightens the flame, unavailable lamps hang dark with punched holes unlit
Responsive/motion: the field narrows to one hanging column on phones; motion is lamp sway and shadow swing on a slow pendulum
concepts.spark: you duck under the lowest lamp and the punched stars slide over your sleeves, the hammer marks catching amber at every dent, and the whole alley shifts its lace as a draft moves the constellation
concepts.webLeverage: svg masks punch the lantern patterns and project them as scaled shadow layers, css transforms swing lamp and shadow together

concepts.form: a wall of planished copper panels riveted in courses, hammer facets catching a raking light, with bright metal, tea-brown oxide and green verdigris recording how recently each panel was worked
concepts.lineage: Coppersmith planishing and cladding, architectural copper roofing, patina chemistry
system: Palette/material: rose copper faceted in even hammer courses, mirror-bright for active, tea-brown oxide at rest, verdigris green for the archive, dark iron rivets as separators
Type/composition: roman caps struck into the metal to read by shadow rather than color, panel seams ruling the columns, dense figures engraved as hairline rows between rivets
Topology/navigation: the wall is a grid of panels laid course by course, sections are panels, and opening one planishes it smooth to full width while neighbors keep their texture
Controls/state: hover rakes light across a panel's facets, a press lands as one bright strike ring, and untouched panels patinate slowly toward green until worked again
Responsive/motion: courses restack to a single column of panels on phones, and motion is only the raking-light sweep and the strike
concepts.spark: You tilt your head and ten thousand hammer blows surface at once across the wall, one panel polished back to rose mirror this morning, its neighbor already going green at the rivets.
concepts.webLeverage: css lighting gradients driven by pointer position do the raking light, and a stored timestamp per panel computes its patina state

concepts.form: a steel-framed glass partition wall from a glazier's workshop, rectilinear panes of hand-rolled sheet glass in a black glazing grid, mostly clear and seeded white with a few saturated color fields placed like notes in a score
concepts.lineage: Steel casement glazing, hand-rolled sheet glass craft, modernist color-field composition
system: Palette/material: matte black glazing bars as the only line ink, clear and seeded-white panes as the calm ground, cobalt, amber and oxblood glass reserved for what matters now
Type/composition: a quiet grotesque set inside a pane and never across a bar, one pane one statement, hierarchy carried by pane size and glass color rather than type weight
Topology/navigation: the wall elevation is the map read left to right, heavier mullions bound the sections, and each pane is one destination you step up to
Controls/state: daylight is rest, hover backlights a pane, selection floods it with its assigned color, and disabled panes frost to translucent white
Responsive/motion: bays restack into a single column keeping true bar thickness, and motion is the slow brightening of glass, nothing slides
concepts.spark: Down the corridor the wall reads almost clear, then one cobalt pane lights from behind and holds, a single saturated note in a grid of black bars and watery white glass.
concepts.webLeverage: css grid draws the glazing bars at true thickness while backdrop-filter and background transitions light the panes

concepts.form: a polished panel incised with a fine scratched line and rubbed with ink so the drawing exists only where the surface is broken, the untouched ground staying luminous and the whole image reading as a network of cuts
concepts.lineage: scrimshaw incising, ink-rubbed line drawing on polished surfaces and sailors' engraved narrative panels
system: Palette/material: a warm polished cream ground with the drawing existing only as ink held inside scratched lines, no wash and no fill anywhere
Type/composition: fine incised hatching building all tone, a narrow decorative border cut around the panel edge, and lettering incised in the same hand
Topology/navigation: only broken surface carries information, so navigation follows the cut lines rather than moving between regions
Controls/state: controls are incised areas, the active one takes a second pass of ink, and untouched ground stays luminous
Responsive/motion: line density rescales without becoming solid, and motion is ink working its way into a fresh cut
concepts.spark: The picture is entirely made of scratches with ink rubbed into them, and the parts nobody cut are the parts that shine.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg incised-line filter with density bound to state, an ink-settling animation per cut, and responsive line scaling

concepts.form: a brocade loom in mid-weave where the pattern exists twice, face and reverse carrying inverted colorways of the same figure, and cut supplementary threads floating loose across the back of every motif
concepts.lineage: figured brocade weaving, supplementary weft technique and inverted face-and-reverse colorway construction
system: Palette/material: silk in three dyed colors plus a metallic-free gold-toned thread, the reverse carrying the same figure with colors exchanged
Type/composition: a repeating figured motif built from supplementary weft, with cut threads floating loose across the reverse of every motif
Topology/navigation: the cloth has two valid faces, so navigation flips between them rather than moving across one
Controls/state: controls are motifs, the active one shows its reverse colorway, and unwoven areas show only the ground warp
Responsive/motion: the motif repeats in whole units at any width, and motion is the cloth turning to show its other face
concepts.spark: Turn it over and the same flowers are there in exchanged colors, with all the cut threads floating loose behind them like working notes.
concepts.webLeverage: css 3d flip revealing an inverted colorway, whole-unit responsive motif repeat, and thread-float rendering on the reverse

concepts.form: a wall of numbered glaze test tiles, each fired identically and differing by one recorded variable, hung in a grid so a single ingredient can be read as a gradient across a row and the recipe printed on every reverse
concepts.lineage: ceramic glaze testing practice, single-variable test tile libraries with recorded recipes and gridded comparison hanging
system: Palette/material: fired glaze surfaces ranging from matte to glassy on identical clay bodies, with the variable producing a genuine visual gradient
Type/composition: a numbered grid of identical tiles, rows organized by one changing ingredient, and the recipe stamped on every reverse
Topology/navigation: rows are variables and columns are steps, so navigation reads a gradient and then reverses a tile to learn why
Controls/state: controls are tiles, the active one turns to show its recipe, and failed firings stay in the grid rather than being removed
Responsive/motion: the grid reflows in whole tiles preserving row order, and motion is a tile turning to its reverse
concepts.spark: Forty tiles, one ingredient changing by two percent along each row, and the recipe for every single one stamped on the back where it cannot get lost.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-tile responsive grid preserving variable order, flip-to-recipe state, and gradient reading across rows

concepts.form: a book bound with its structure showing, chain-stitch links running exposed down the spine between wooden boards, the sewing pattern itself serving as the only ornament the binding gets
concepts.lineage: Coptic exposed chain-stitch binding, wooden-board covers and structure-as-ornament sewing practice
system: Palette/material: undyed linen thread against wooden boards and unbleached rag paper, with blind tooling as the only surface decoration
Type/composition: chain-stitch links running the full spine in a visible repeating pattern, sections aligned so every link sits on a shared axis
Topology/navigation: the binding lies fully flat so navigation opens any section completely rather than fighting a curved gutter
Controls/state: controls are sections, the active one opens flat, and the stitch pattern shows exactly how many sections remain
Responsive/motion: link count scales with section count and the spine grows visibly, and motion is a book opening completely flat
concepts.spark: Nothing is hidden. The thread that holds the book together runs down the outside of the spine in a chain, and that chain is the only decoration it was ever given.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg chain-stitch spine generated from live section count, flat-open section state, and a growth animation as sections are added

concepts.form: a papier-mache surface built up in lacquered layers and painted with a brush of a few hairs, dense floral repeats laid in flat colour then outlined in a hairline that is drawn last and never corrected
concepts.lineage: Kashmiri papier-mâché naqashi painting, layered lacquer grounds and single-hair outlining practice
system: Palette/material: burnished lacquer ground in deep blue or black, flat mineral colour laid over it, and a hairline outline drawn last in a lighter tone
Type/composition: a dense all-over floral repeat with no ground showing, every element closed by an outline finer than the shapes it contains
Topology/navigation: the repeat covers everything, so navigation moves through density rather than between regions
Controls/state: controls are motifs, the active one receives its final hairline, and unfinished ones sit as flat colour without outline
Responsive/motion: the repeat retiles at any scale while the hairline holds its true width, and motion is an outline drawn in one unbroken pass
concepts.spark: The colour goes down first and means nothing; the whole thing only becomes an image when someone draws a line finer than a hair around every single petal, in one pass, with no way to fix it.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg repeat with a non-scaling hairline stroke, outline-draw animation per motif, and finished state per element

concepts.form: a black lacquer box painted with a narrative in tempera and finished in gold line, figures elongated against an unrelieved black ground with the gold drawn last as the only light in the composition
concepts.lineage: Palekh lacquer miniature painting, black papier-mâché grounds, egg tempera narrative and final gold-line finishing
system: Palette/material: unrelieved black lacquer ground with egg tempera figures and a final gold line that supplies every highlight in the composition
Type/composition: elongated figures arranged around the lid's edge with the centre often left black, and a gold border enclosing the whole field
Topology/navigation: black is the default state and gold marks everything that matters, so navigation follows the gold
Controls/state: controls are figures, the active one takes its gold line, and inactive ones remain tempera against black
Responsive/motion: the black ground absorbs any reflow while figures hold their proportion, and motion is gold line drawn last over settled colour
concepts.spark: Everything is painted first and looks unfinished, and then the gold goes on last in lines thinner than thread and suddenly the whole black lid has light in it.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg gold-line layer drawn after colour with stroke animation, black-ground responsive absorption, and per-figure highlight state

concepts.form: a vessel of blackened alloy inlaid with pure silver sheet, the metal darkened permanently by a soil paste so the inlay reads as bright figure against a black that can never lighten
concepts.lineage: Bidriware zinc-alloy inlay of the Deccan, silver sheet inlay and soil-paste blackening practice
system: Palette/material: a matte permanently blackened alloy with pure silver inlay set flush to the surface, and no third material anywhere
Type/composition: an all-over vine or poppy repeat in silver against black, the inlay always flush so the surface reads as one plane
Topology/navigation: figure and ground never trade places, so navigation moves along the silver as a continuous path
Controls/state: controls are inlay runs, the active one catches light along its length, and the ground stays absolutely black
Responsive/motion: the repeat retiles at any scale with the inlay width held true, and motion is light travelling the silver
concepts.spark: The black is not paint and will never fade, and the silver sits perfectly flush inside it, so the pattern is not on the surface, it is the surface.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg flush-inlay repeat with a travelling specular highlight, non-scaling inlay width, and a fixed absolute-black ground

concepts.form: a workshop board of commissioned figurative coffins, each carved as the object a life was spent on and painted in high-gloss enamel, with the shop's catalogue of shapes chalked on the wall behind
concepts.lineage: Ghanaian figurative coffin carving, commissioned life-object forms and enamel finishing with a chalked shop catalogue
system: Palette/material: high-gloss enamel over carved and filled wood in unmixed saturated colour, finished to a wet shine with no matte anywhere
Type/composition: one commissioned object per form, scaled to a body, with the shop's available shapes chalked in a list on the wall behind
Topology/navigation: the catalogue is a list of lives, so navigation moves between forms that each stand for an occupation
Controls/state: controls are catalogue entries, the active one turns to show its commissioned form, and completed ones leave the board
Responsive/motion: the catalogue reflows in whole entries, and motion is a form turning under a gloss highlight
concepts.spark: A fisherman gets a fish, a pilot gets an aeroplane, and the whole catalogue of what a life can be is chalked on the workshop wall in a list.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-entry responsive catalogue, turn-to-reveal state per form, and a gloss highlight travelling the enamel

concepts.form: a painted trunk lid worked in scrolling ornament where the valley you learned in determines the scroll, one school running loose and asymmetric while the next keeps everything symmetrical and tight
concepts.lineage: Norwegian rosemaling valley schools, regional scroll grammars and painted trunk and cupboard ornament
system: Palette/material: milk paint on a deep ground of ox blood or blue green, ornament in cream and rust with a single fine outlining stroke
Type/composition: C and S scrolls growing from one root point, either loose and asymmetric or tight and mirrored depending on the school
Topology/navigation: schools are the taxonomy, so navigation compares the same object painted under different regional rules
Controls/state: controls are scroll roots, the active one grows its scroll in its school's manner, and other schools show as ghosts
Responsive/motion: scrolls extend to fill any lid proportion, and motion is a scroll growing from its root in one stroke
concepts.spark: Two trunks painted the same year fifty kilometres apart, and anyone from the region can tell you instantly which valley each painter learned in.
concepts.webLeverage: svg scroll paths generated per school grammar, comparative ghost overlays, and a root-outward growth animation

concepts.form: a shallow plate coiled from salvaged telephone wire, colour patterns named after what they resemble and built by choosing which insulated wires to buy, the pattern existing before a single coil is made
concepts.lineage: Zulu izimbenge telephone-wire plate weaving, salvaged insulated wire colour selection and named pattern naming
system: Palette/material: insulated telephone wire in whatever colours the salvage yard held, coiled tight so colour reads as fine concentric line
Type/composition: concentric coiled rounds building a radial pattern, with the pattern named for what it resembles rather than for its geometry
Topology/navigation: everything grows from a centre outward, so navigation moves radially rather than laterally
Controls/state: controls are rounds, the active one adds its colour to the coil, and the available palette is fixed by what was salvaged
Responsive/motion: rounds add outward to any diameter, and motion is a coil winding from the centre
concepts.spark: The colours are whatever the scrapyard had that week, which is why one plate is called lightning and the next one, made from a different pile of wire, is called rain.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg radial coil built round by round from a constrained palette, outward growth animation, and named-pattern state

concepts.form: a marbling shop selling sheets by named pattern, combs and rakes of fixed tooth spacing producing nonpareil, peacock and Spanish wave to order, every sheet unique but every pattern reproducible
concepts.lineage: trade marbling for bookbinders, named pattern repertoires and fixed-spacing comb and rake tooling
system: Palette/material: pigment floated on carrageenan and lifted onto sized paper, colours never blending but pushing each other into veins
Type/composition: a named pattern produced by a specific comb sequence, filling the sheet edge to edge with no margin or focal point
Topology/navigation: patterns are a catalogue, so navigation moves between named results rather than between compositions
Controls/state: controls are comb passes, each one permanently transforms the whole bath, and a lift fixes the result
Responsive/motion: the pattern fills any sheet size without a focal point, and motion is a comb drawn through the whole bath at once
concepts.spark: Every sheet is one of a kind and yet the pattern has a name and a price, because the comb has fixed teeth and the shop has been pulling nonpareil for ninety years.
concepts.webLeverage: a bath simulation transformed by fixed-spacing comb passes, named pattern presets, and a full-bleed responsive result

concepts.form: a symmetrical paper roundel cut from folded sheets and then built up in layers of flat colour, each layer cut separately and pasted over the last so the figure gains depth without any shading
concepts.lineage: Polish Łowicz wycinanki papercutting, folded symmetrical cutting and layered flat-colour construction
system: Palette/material: glossy flat papers in unmixed colour pasted in layers, with depth made only by overlap and never by tone
Type/composition: a symmetrical roundel cut from a fold, with cockerels and flowers built up in separately cut colour layers
Topology/navigation: the composition builds outward in layers, so navigation adds a layer rather than moving to a new view
Controls/state: controls are layers, the active one pastes over the ones beneath, and removing one exposes the layer below intact
Responsive/motion: the roundel scales while the fold symmetry holds exactly, and motion is a layer settling onto the stack
concepts.spark: There is no shading anywhere, and yet the cockerel has depth, because it is nine separate pieces of coloured paper cut one at a time and pasted on top of each other.
concepts.webLeverage: layered svg cut shapes with exact fold symmetry, per-layer paste and removal state, and a settle animation

concepts.form: a symmetrical scene cut from one folded sheet with no piece ever added, the whole image held together by the paper bridges the cutter chose to leave, mounted against a contrasting ground
concepts.lineage: German and Swiss Scherenschnitte papercutting, single-sheet folded cutting and bridge-dependent composition
system: Palette/material: a single black sheet cut and mounted on cream, with no second colour and no added element anywhere in the work
Type/composition: a symmetrical scene where every element must connect to another by a paper bridge or it falls out of the design
Topology/navigation: connectivity is a hard constraint, so navigation follows the bridges that hold the whole composition together
Controls/state: controls are bridges, the active one highlights what depends on it, and cutting one drops everything beyond
Responsive/motion: the cut scales while bridge widths hold true, and motion is a bridge being cut and its dependents falling
concepts.spark: Every single part of the picture has to physically touch another part or it simply falls on the floor, so the composition is really a study in what is holding what.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg cut with a real connectivity graph, dependency highlighting per bridge, and a fall-away animation on cut

families.label: Fashion & Folded Worlds
families.description: Garments, textiles, paper, pleats, folds, drape, body, and transformation from flat material into inhabited form.

concepts.form: an overhead canopy of translucent indigo, madder, and saffron silk crossing a sunlit courtyard, where independently tensioned banners overlap into passing color chords and sudden clear sky
concepts.lineage: South Asian shamiana canopy craft, color-light composition, and kinetic textile installation
system: Palette/material: translucent indigo, madder, and saffron silk over sun-white paving, overlap violets and browns as computed chord states, clear sky white as rest
Type/composition: light wide-tracked sans labels pinned at each banner's tensioned edge, the composition horizontal silk lanes crossing one bright open field
Topology/navigation: Move among individual banner voices, their crossing zones, the courtyard ground, and moments when several colors coincide.
Controls/state: Tension, release, solo, and align bands with separate, approaching, overlapping, dissonant, and clear states labeled beyond color.
Responsive/motion: Recompose the canopy as synchronized translucent lanes on compact screens and provide patterned stills for
concepts.spark: A wind lifts the indigo span above the saffron; violet races across the paving, a madder band joins for one deep brown chord, and then the courtyard flashes white again.
concepts.webLeverage: Synchronized state channels can be soloed or combined in real time, making overlap a task-bearing joint state that remains scrubbable, comparable, and noncolor-coded.

concepts.form: a circular sheet folded along one sweeping curved crease, where paper rises into a rigid shell without straight facets or added support
concepts.lineage: Curved-crease origami, geometric sculpture, and thin-shell research
system: Palette/material: cream cotton paper as ground, one charcoal compass arc as the active crease, graphite shadow gradients for depth, body notes in soft black ink
Type/composition: geometer's inclined serif italic for labels, figures numbered like plates, layout ruled by the sweep of one arc rather than a rectangular grid
Topology/navigation: Connect planar crease, local curvature, ridge, and resulting shell through registered views.
Controls/state: Bend, invert, lock, and compare with flat, curving, stable, buckled, and reversed states.
Responsive/motion: Pair plan and section on small screens and expose a small set of stable key forms.
concepts.spark: The cream disc lifts along one charcoal arc and locks into a saddle whose shadow looks drawn with a compass in midair.
concepts.webLeverage: A curve-driven deformation model can show how one line produces spatial rigidity while retaining a precise 2D source.

concepts.form: a vast Miura-fold sheet unfolding from a hand-sized packet, where one pull deploys a precise field of linked mountain and valley creases
concepts.lineage: Miura-ori geometry, deployable aerospace structures, and folded maps
system: Palette/material: matte white sheet as ground, gold foil packet face as the accent, mountain creases scored in warm gray, valley creases in pale blue, body ink near-black
Type/composition: aerospace spec mono for crease ids, a parallelogram grid ruling every block, headings folded along the tessellation's diagonal seams
Topology/navigation: Move between compact packet, crease cell, linked row, and fully deployed sheet.
Controls/state: Pull, lock, reverse, and inspect with folded, opening, deployed, misfolded, and collapsed states.
Responsive/motion: Use stepped deployment on small screens and preserve the complete crease graph as an accessible diagram.
concepts.spark: A gold packet no larger than a book is tugged at two corners and opens in one breath into a rigid tessellated sail spanning the floor.
concepts.webLeverage: Constraint-linked geometry can make one control propagate across the sheet while adaptive detail protects performance.

concepts.form: a single square of vermilion washi becoming an orizuru crane through thirty-two deliberate folds, where one uncut sheet passes from flat geometry to beak, wings, hollow body, and a balanced standing silhouette
concepts.lineage: Japanese origami practice, the orizuru crane, washi papermaking, traditional folding sequence, and crease-pattern geometry
system: Palette/material: vermilion washi as ground with visible kozo fiber, crease lines in faded fold-white, one gold dot marking the active step, notes in sumi black ink
Type/composition: quiet humanist sans beside kanji step names, folds numbered one to thirty-two in a strict margin column, diagrams square and centered like the uncut sheet
Topology/navigation: Connect face, edge, mountain crease, valley crease, preliminary base, bird base, flap, and finished crane as one continuous sheet.
Controls/state: Fold, unfold, rotate, reverse, and replay with flat, creased, collapsed, based, locked, finished, and recoverable states.
Responsive/motion: Pair the active crease pattern with one authored spatial view and provide discrete fold states under
concepts.spark: The red square closes into a small diamond, opens into a long-necked bird, and with one final pull spreads two crisp wings that still carry every earlier crease.
concepts.webLeverage: Constraint-aware direct manipulation can prevent impossible folds, synchronize the crease pattern with the spatial crane, and deep-link any recoverable step for teaching or return.

concepts.form: a bias-cut satin garment suspended from a single shoulder, where diagonal grain turns gravity into a continuous spiraling line around the body
concepts.lineage: Bias-cut couture, draping on the form, and satin grain behavior
system: Palette/material: silver satin sheen as ground deepening to charcoal in shadow, seam threads in bone white, one claret pin marking the anchor point, body ink in ink-navy
Type/composition: high-contrast didone italics that lean with the grain, baselines set at forty-five degrees to the selvage, sparse labels hung from the shoulder anchor
Topology/navigation: Trace grain direction, anchor point, body contact, and free fall as one continuous route.
Controls/state: Pin, rotate grain, release, and compare with supported, clinging, twisting, and hanging states.
Responsive/motion: Use grain maps and chosen drape poses on compact screens instead of continuous simulation.
concepts.spark: Silver satin leaves one shoulder, crosses the torso without a hard seam, and falls into a long helix that tightens as the wearer walks.
concepts.webLeverage: A low-resolution cloth solve can demonstrate grain consequence while detailed geometry loads only around selected regions.

concepts.form: a black velvet field embroidered with conductive silver thread, where touched constellations of stitches answer with low warm light
concepts.lineage: Goldwork embroidery, electronic textiles, and interactive fiber art
system: Palette/material: black velvet pile as ground, couched silver thread carrying every route, amber ember glow as the active state, resting labels stitched in pale bone
Type/composition: needlework script for motif names with small stitched caps for routes, composition following couched lines rather than columns, knots as bullet marks
Topology/navigation: Follow stitched routes through knots, branches, motifs, and larger regions with endpoints clear.
Controls/state: Touch, trace, connect, and mute with dormant, conducting, lit, fading, and broken-thread states.
Responsive/motion: Replace traveling light with focused path highlighting and ensure every route has a textual name and state.
concepts.spark: A fingertip follows a silver stitched branch; amber light travels behind it one knot at a time, then slowly extinguishes from the origin.
concepts.webLeverage: Pointer, keyboard, or sensor input can drive a shared path graph across visual light and accessible route feedback.

concepts.form: a wide silk cape threaded with hidden drawcord channels, where one pull transforms a flat plane into ribs, gathers, and a protective volume
concepts.lineage: Transformable garments, drawstring construction, and deployable textile form
system: Palette/material: matte black silk as ground, one gold drawcord as accent and control, channel stitching in graphite, gathered shadow rendered in slate
Type/composition: narrow tailored grotesk with wide tracking like topstitching, labels riding the cord channels, the semicircle's radius ruling all alignment
Topology/navigation: Trace cord channel, gathered region, anchor, and complete silhouette through each transformation.
Controls/state: Pull, lock, release, and compare with flat, gathering, shaped, tensioned, and relaxed states.
Responsive/motion: Offer a small set of named silhouettes on phones and let users advance transformations stepwise.
concepts.spark: The cape begins as a black semicircle; one gold cord is pulled and the cloth rises into a pleated shell around the shoulders.
concepts.webLeverage: A constraint-driven cloth model can demonstrate functional transformation while static pattern and pose views remain complete.

concepts.form: a floor-length silk column held in thousands of permanent irregular pleats, where reflected color deepens and disappears as the body turns
concepts.lineage: Heat-set silk pleating, bias-aware dress construction, and early modern fashion innovation
system: Palette/material: bronze pleated silk as ground, molten green catchlight reserved for the open active fan, seam cords in muted umber, notes in deep sepia ink
Type/composition: slender venetian capitals letterspaced like pleat intervals, text set in narrow vertical columns that compress and open with the silk
Topology/navigation: Organize the form through pleat field, seam, body zone, and movement pose rather than flat panels.
Controls/state: Turn, gather, release, and compare with compressed, opening, flowing, and resting states.
Responsive/motion: Replace simulated drape with selected poses on small screens and include pattern geometry for nonvisual access.
concepts.spark: The bronze silk dress seems narrow and still, then a turn opens hundreds of fine pleats into a brief fan of molten green light.
concepts.webLeverage: Adaptive cloth geometry can focus detail near interaction while a pose strip preserves the full sequence.

concepts.form: an indigo ikat cloth whose threads were dyed before weaving, where calculated bindings meet inevitable blur at every colored edge
concepts.lineage: Resist-dyed ikat traditions across Southeast and Central Asia
system: Palette/material: deep indigo ground, undyed thread white for resist edges, every boundary feathered by design, one saturated madder red band as the active register
Type/composition: soft-edged slab letters that blur at their flanks like dyed warp, a strict weaving grid beneath deliberately offset alignment, motifs in mirrored halves
Topology/navigation: Move between dye plan, bound thread group, woven crossing, and resulting motif.
Controls/state: Bind, dye, shift, weave, and compare with reserved, saturated, registered, offset, and blended states.
Responsive/motion: Pair a thread map with the woven result and preserve offsets through labeled grids rather than blur alone.
concepts.spark: Dark blue diamonds almost align across the cloth, but each edge flickers into pale threads as if the pattern were remembering motion.
concepts.webLeverage: Thread-level registration can show how small offsets accumulate into a distinctive soft-edged whole.

concepts.form: a jacquard brocade woven from punched instructions, where thousands of binary thread choices resolve into a gold bird across midnight silk
concepts.lineage: Jacquard weaving, punched-card computation, and figured brocade
system: Palette/material: midnight blue silk as ground, gold weft floats as the accent motif, punch-card cream for instruction rows, warp shadow in near-black ink
Type/composition: monospaced ledger digits for card rows, motif titles in woven small caps, layout banded row by row like the loom's lift sequence
Topology/navigation: Move between finished motif, weave row, card, and individual warp lift with full traceability.
Controls/state: Punch, lift, throw, reverse, and compare with encoded, raised, woven, skipped, and corrected states.
Responsive/motion: Present the loom as synchronized pattern and instruction rows and make every thread choice keyboard inspectable.
concepts.spark: Rows of tiny holes pass above the loom; beneath them, gold weft slowly gathers into a bird whose wing spans hundreds of separate thread decisions.
concepts.webLeverage: A shared binary matrix can drive textile rendering, editing, and an exact accessible instruction representation.

concepts.form: a monumental lace hanging built from knots and deliberate absence, where the empty openings carry as much structure as the thread
concepts.lineage: Bobbin lace, architectural textile installation, and openwork pattern
system: Palette/material: bone-white linen thread over a near-black floor ground, openings kept as true dark voids, one honey sunlight pass marking the active motif
Type/composition: fine openwork serif with generous counters, headings framed by pattern repeats, whitespace treated as drawn structure equal to the text
Topology/navigation: Treat knot, connection, opening, motif, and complete hanging as equal navigable scales.
Controls/state: Knot, cross, open, repair, and compare with connected, tensioned, open, snagged, and mended states.
Responsive/motion: Collapse dense motifs into named regions and provide a high-contrast structural diagram.
concepts.spark: Sun passes through a white lace wall and projects a second, sharper cathedral of empty diamonds across the dark floor.
concepts.webLeverage: Vector openwork can zoom across scales while preserving every connection and negative region as semantic geometry.

concepts.form: a hand-pieced quilt assembled from worn garments and handwritten cloth, where every block carries a different body, date, and domestic history
concepts.lineage: Community quilting, memory cloth, and vernacular textile archives
system: Palette/material: pieced grounds of faded chambray blue, worn shirt stripe, and funeral black, bright new stitch red as the accent line, captions in iron-gall brown
Type/composition: handwritten cloth labels beside plain block caps, a block grid of unequal patches, every caption seamed to its fabric with a visible stitch rule
Topology/navigation: Enter through block, seam, owner, date, or repeated fabric while the complete quilt remains visible.
Controls/state: Add, place, cite, turn, and compare with inherited, cut, pieced, quilted, and repaired states.
Responsive/motion: Reflow blocks into a chronological patch sequence and keep every provenance link readable.
concepts.spark: A faded shirt cuff, a child's red pocket, and a square of funeral black meet under one line of bright new stitching.
concepts.webLeverage: Deep zoom and linked metadata can preserve material intimacy while supporting many independent stories.

concepts.form: a long indigo cloth bound, stitched, and folded before dyeing, where white resist lines preserve the exact memory of pressure and thread
concepts.lineage: Japanese shibori resist-dye traditions
system: Palette/material: saturated indigo ground, resist-line white carrying every path, thread punctures as pale points, one wet deeper indigo pool marking the active fold
Type/composition: brush-informed sans in unbleached white on indigo, composition banded by fold lines, step numbers stitched along the binding routes
Topology/navigation: Connect finished mark to fold, stitch, binding point, and dye exposure.
Controls/state: Fold, bind, stitch, immerse, and unfold with exposed, resisted, saturated, bleeding, and revealed states.
Responsive/motion: Pair binding diagrams with final cloth and use a step sequence instead of decorative liquid effects.
concepts.spark: The wet bundle opens to reveal a white river branching through deep indigo, each fork ending at a tiny puncture left by removed thread.
concepts.webLeverage: Registered folding and resist maps can reveal causal transformation from compact bundle to opened cloth.

concepts.form: a warp-weighted loom leaning against a wall, where hanging stones keep vertical threads alive with unequal but visible tension
concepts.lineage: Ancient warp-weighted weaving and archaeological textile reconstruction
system: Palette/material: undyed white warp as ground, clay-weight terracotta for anchors, one red weft pass as the active line, shed shadow in deep umber
Type/composition: inscriptional capitals cut like loom marks, text hung in vertical warp columns, each finished row beaten upward into a dense woven band
Topology/navigation: Read vertically from weight to warp group, shed, woven band, and growing cloth.
Controls/state: Lift, weight, tension, pass, and beat with slack, open, crossed, packed, and broken states.
Responsive/motion: Turn the loom into a vertical thread ledger and animate only deliberate user-driven passes.
concepts.spark: Clay weights hang in a staggered row beneath white warp; one lifted tablet opens a dark shed and the red weft passes across.
concepts.webLeverage: A constraint model can connect each hanging weight to visible thread tension and weaving consequences.

concepts.form: an akari workshop, washi over bamboo ribs folded into glowing moons and columns, paper diffusing one bare bulb into weightless warm volumes that ship flat
concepts.lineage: Isamu Noguchi's Akari light sculptures, Gifu lantern craft, sculptural light design
system: Palette/material: candlelit washi ivory glowing as the ground, bamboo rib tan for structure lines, charcoal for body ink, one vermilion stamp as the active mark
Type/composition: a light humanist sans beside a brush-stamped mark, rib lines banding the page into gentle segments that bow like paper under light
Topology/navigation: lit volumes hang and stand at different heights in one dim room; you move between glows, and unlit forms wait folded flat against the wall
Controls/state: the bulb is the state, on means inhabited and warm, hover brightens the paper from inside, dismissed volumes fold flat to a rib outline
Responsive/motion: small screens collapse volumes to their flat shipping outlines that reopen on tap; motion is a soft unfolding inflation
concepts.spark: You hold a bamboo rib hoop while sheets of washi dry on the rack; when the bulb inside snaps on, the folded column beside you becomes a warm moon, weightless, and its light lands on your hands like paper.
concepts.webLeverage: layered box-shadow and radial-gradient glow through translucent paper textures, view transition unfolding panels from flat to volume

concepts.form: a white-painted atelier, garments carrying blank labels held by four white pick stitches, exposed linings and raw hems as the finish, line numbers 0 to 23 circled on cotton tape
concepts.lineage: Maison Margiela, deconstructed tailoring, anonymous white-coat atelier practice
system: Palette/material: whitewash over every surface, cotton tape white on raw canvas ecru, black typewriter ink for numerals, the hand-drawn circle as the only accent
Type/composition: plain typewriter numerals on cotton tape and blank labels, seams and structure left exposed, the composition an inventory line 0 to 23
Topology/navigation: the numbered line 0 to 23 is the whole map; each numeral is a department, and you arrive by circling one on the tape
Controls/state: selection is a hand-drawn circle around a numeral, the blank label is the unnamed default, four white pick stitches mark what can be opened
Responsive/motion: the tape wraps to as many rows as the width allows, numerals never shrink; motion is a garment turned lining-out
concepts.spark: You stand in a workshop where everything, tables, telephone, doorframe, is painted flat white; a garment on the rail wears its lining outward, and you turn a collar to find a blank label held by four white stitches.
concepts.webLeverage: css dashed borders and outline exposing element seams as construction, :checked state drawing an svg circle stroke around the chosen numeral

concepts.form: an industrial streetwear grammar, ordinary words set in straight quotation marks, zip-tie tags left on, diagonal hazard stripes crossing white cotton and black nylon
concepts.lineage: Virgil Abloh's Off-White, quotation-mark labeling, workwear appropriation
system: Palette/material: stockroom white cotton and black nylon as ground and ink, black-on-white hazard diagonals for structure, safety orange zip-tie tags as the accent
Type/composition: bold industrial caps inside straight quotation marks naming the obvious, label plates set square on the grid like stenciled crates
Topology/navigation: every zone is labeled with its literal quoted name, wayfinding is reading, and the hazard stripe runs diagonally under whatever matters
Controls/state: the active item keeps its orange zip tie on, toggles read "ON" and "OFF" in quotes, disabled things take the diagonal stripe across them
Responsive/motion: stripes hold 45 degrees at every width while label plates stack; motion is a tag swinging once on selection
concepts.spark: You lift a jacket and the zip-tie tag clacks against the hanger; across the back, giant caps in straight quotes name the obvious, and a hazard stripe runs diagonally under the fluorescent light of the stockroom.
concepts.webLeverage: css repeating-linear-gradient hazard stripes at 45deg, generated content wrapping every label in straight quotes via ::before and ::after

concepts.form: a sneaker archive wall, stacked cardboard boxes with silhouette line art printed on the ends, colorway names read as poetry beside monospaced size runs, tissue folded inside each lid
concepts.lineage: sneaker box design, sneakerhead archive culture, the colorway naming tradition
system: Palette/material: burnt orange box board as the ground, black one-line silhouette art for ink, tissue white interiors, the colorway chip strip carrying accent states
Type/composition: condensed caps on the end label over monospaced size-run digits, the label grid of name, colorway, and size ruling every card
Topology/navigation: a wall of stacked boxes indexed by their end labels; you browse the stack face, pull a box halfway, and open the lid to go deeper
Controls/state: the selected box slides half out of the stack, opening hinges the lid and folds back tissue, the colorway chip marks which variant is live
Responsive/motion: the wall re-shelves to a single column of end labels on narrow screens; motion is lid hinge and tissue lift
concepts.spark: You slide a box from a stack taller than you; the end label lists the colorway name like a line of verse, the lid lifts with a cardboard sigh, and tissue paper folds back from the shape you already know by silhouette.
concepts.webLeverage: css 3d transforms hinging box lids open on interaction, grid re-shelving the stack from wall to single column across breakpoints

concepts.form: a west african wax print market wall, six-yard cuts stacked in loud harmonious towers, saturated pattern systems veined with wax-resist crackle, named designs trading in social meaning
concepts.lineage: Dutch wax and Ankara printing, Vlisco pattern naming, Ghanaian and Nigerian cloth markets, Akosombo Textiles
system: Palette/material: marigold, teal, and oxblood grounds veined with indigo wax crackle, selvedge white for margins, the loudest print reserved for the active cut
Type/composition: pattern names in confident slab capitals like selvedge stamps, content banded as stacked horizontal bolts, edge-to-edge repeat with no timid whitespace
Topology/navigation: the wall is a vertical stack of folded bolts; you flip downward through the cuts, and pulling one bolt unfolds it full width over the stack
Controls/state: selection pulls a bolt proud of the stack and unfolds a yard of it, quantity reads as stack height, the pattern's given name confirms every choice
Responsive/motion: stacks narrow to single-bolt columns keeping full-bleed repeats; motion is cloth unfolding in one throw
concepts.spark: You stand in a market stall walled floor to ceiling with folded wax prints, the seller throwing a six-yard cut open across the counter in one motion, crackle veins running through a marigold fan pattern she calls by name.
concepts.webLeverage: css background repeats build the pattern fields while blend modes lay indigo crackle veins over every ground

concepts.form: a home sewing pattern envelope and its tissue, fashion figures in three lettered views on the front, yardage tables on the back, and inside a folded map of dashed cutting lines, notches, grain arrows, and place-on-fold brackets
concepts.lineage: Butterick, Simplicity, and McCall's printed patterns, 1960s and 70s envelope illustration and tissue drafting
system: Palette/material: manila tissue ground with black drafting marks, envelope figures in dry gouache pastels, one dressmaker red tracing the view and size you have committed to
Type/composition: view letters A, B, and C rank the variants, circled piece numbers sit on every tissue shape, instructions run as numbered steps with thumbnail diagrams
Topology/navigation: the envelope front indexes the views, the back holds size and yardage tables, and the cutting layout maps every numbered piece onto the folded yardage
Controls/state: the chosen size renders its nested cut line solid while other sizes stay dashed, notches must meet to join pieces, and a placed piece pins flat and stops drifting
Responsive/motion: the layout refolds to the fabric width at hand, pieces never rotating off grain; motion is tissue settling and a pin dropping home
concepts.spark: You smooth the crackling tissue across the table, third size line from the edge, and pin piece 4 with its grain arrow dead parallel to the fold before the scissors commit you to view B.
concepts.webLeverage: css outlines trace nested size grading while drag interaction snaps svg pieces onto a grain-locked layout grid

concepts.form: a woven tartan and its registry page, the sett written as a thread count in wool shorthand, colors crossing over themselves into blended intersections, each clan's pattern a recorded recipe any mill can weave true
concepts.lineage: Scottish tartan mills and pattern books, thread-count sett notation, the civic register of named tartans
system: Palette/material: a declared roster of wool tones per tartan, hunter green, navy, and carmine crossing on twill so every overlap births a blended third tone, selvedge as margin
Type/composition: the sett line in mono shorthand like K4 R32 G32, small-caps captions beneath a woven specimen swatch, the pattern itself carrying the identity
Topology/navigation: the registry lists named setts; opening one unfolds its repeat full width, and zoom descends from cloth to thread grid where the recipe becomes countable
Controls/state: editing the thread count reweaves the cloth live, the pivot thread mirrors the sequence back on itself, and a registered sett locks its recipe line
Responsive/motion: the repeat tiles to any width by weaving more of itself, never stretching; motion is the sett filling in thread by thread
concepts.spark: The mill clerk reads K4 R32 G32 off the registry card and the loom answers, navy crossing carmine into a muted plum at every intersection, a family's whole identity stated in one countable line.
concepts.webLeverage: a canvas loom renders any thread-count string into true blended twill in real time, with css fallback repeats for static views

concepts.form: a long coat whose entire back panel is worked solid in gold satin stitch, so densely embroidered that no twill shows through at all, an arced slogan banner crossing the shoulders above a mass of stitched cloud and wave
concepts.lineage: Japanese embroidered gang coats, gold-thread slogan work and full-back satin stitch density, group banner conventions
system: Palette/material: gold and scarlet thread worked so dense the dark twill disappears, light reading entirely off the direction of the satin stitch
Type/composition: an arced slogan banner across the shoulders, a fully stitched back panel of cloud and wave beneath it, and a stitched year at the hem
Topology/navigation: the panel is one continuous embroidered field, so navigation moves across stitch direction rather than between separate elements
Controls/state: controls are stitched regions, the active one catches light along its thread direction, and unworked areas show bare twill
Responsive/motion: the arc reflows across whatever width the shoulders give, and motion is light travelling along the stitch direction
concepts.spark: the whole back of the coat is gold thread, not a pattern on cloth but a solid worked surface with no cloth left showing, and the light moves across it differently depending on which way the needle went.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg arced text path reflowing responsive, a light-travel animation following stitch direction, and worked-region state

concepts.form: a forearm stacked solid with beaded cuffs, each one spelling a word in alphabet beads on a strung grid, the cuffs traded and swapped until the arm is a shifting ledger of everyone met
concepts.lineage: rave kandi beadwork, alphabet bead cuff construction on strung grids, trade and exchange convention
system: Palette/material: opaque plastic pony beads in unmixed primaries and neon, strung on elastic so the grid flexes, with white alphabet beads carrying every word
Type/composition: words spelled on a strung bead grid where each letter is one bead, cuffs stacked up the forearm in the order they were traded
Topology/navigation: the stack is chronological, so navigation moves up the arm through the order things were exchanged
Controls/state: controls are cuffs, the active one rotates to show its word, and traded ones move position in the stack
Responsive/motion: the bead grid reflows in whole beads, and motion is a cuff rotating around the arm
concepts.spark: a whole forearm of beaded cuffs, each spelling something out one bead per letter, and every single one was made by somebody else and swapped for one of yours.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg bead grid reflowing in whole units, cuff rotation animation on state, and trade order persisted local

concepts.form: a raffia panel worked in cut pile where an interlocking geometric pattern is deliberately broken partway through, the weaver changing the repeat mid-field so that no panel resolves the way the eye predicts
concepts.lineage: Kuba raffia cut-pile textiles of the Congo basin, interlocking geometric repeats and deliberate pattern interruption
system: Palette/material: undyed raffia against tannin browns and black, texture carrying the pattern as much as tone, with a velvety cut-pile surface
Type/composition: an interlocking geometric repeat covering the whole panel, interrupted at least once by a deliberate shift in the repeat
Topology/navigation: the eye follows a repeat until it breaks, so navigation is tracking a pattern to the point where it refuses
Controls/state: controls are pattern regions, the active one breaks its repeat visibly, and resolved regions continue undisturbed
Responsive/motion: the repeat retiles at any size and always carries at least one break, and motion is a repeat shifting out of phase
concepts.spark: You follow the pattern across the cloth waiting for it to repeat, and about two thirds of the way over the weaver simply decides it will not.
concepts.webLeverage: a generative svg repeat that introduces deliberate breaks at any size, region state, and a phase-shift animation

concepts.form: a heavy felted shepherd coat covered in squared appliqué flower blocks, each block cut from flat cloth and stitched down as a hard-edged rectangle so the whole garment reads as a tiled field of colour
concepts.lineage: Hungarian szűr shepherd coat appliqué, squared cut-cloth flower blocks and regional tailor pattern books
system: Palette/material: heavy undyed felt with appliqué in flat scarlet, black and green wool cloth, every shape cut rather than embroidered
Type/composition: flower motifs squared into hard-edged rectangular blocks tiled across the garment, with a wider block band at the hem
Topology/navigation: the garment is a tiled field, so navigation moves block to block across a surface with no centre
Controls/state: controls are blocks, the active one lifts its appliqué edge, and empty ground shows the bare felt
Responsive/motion: blocks retile in whole units at any width, and motion is an appliqué edge lifting and settling
concepts.spark: Flowers cut out of flat cloth and squared off into rectangles, tiled across a coat heavy enough to sleep under in a field.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-block responsive tiling, appliqué lift state per block, and felt-texture ground layers

concepts.form: an indigo cloth painted in cassava-paste resist before dyeing, hand-drawn motif fields divided into squares where each square carries a named pattern and the dye takes everywhere the paste is not
concepts.lineage: Yoruba adire eleko cassava-paste resist dyeing, named motif squares and indigo vat practice
system: Palette/material: deep indigo cloth where the image exists only as the pale ground the paste protected, with crackle where the paste broke in the vat
Type/composition: the cloth divided into squares, each carrying one named motif drawn freehand, with no square exactly matching its neighbour
Topology/navigation: squares are named so navigation moves by motif name rather than by position
Controls/state: controls are squares, the active one shows its name, and resist crackle marks where the paste failed
Responsive/motion: the square grid reflows in whole units, and motion is dye taking everywhere unprotected
concepts.spark: You do not paint the pattern, you paint everything that will not be the pattern, and then the indigo decides how much of your intention survives.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg resist mask rendered as negative space, whole-square responsive grid, and a dye-take animation revealing the ground

concepts.form: an elm-bark robe worked with a mirrored border pattern that thickens at every opening, appliqué and chain stitch curling into hooks and spirals concentrated exactly where cuff, hem and collar leave the body exposed
concepts.lineage: Ainu attus elm-bark robe patterning, mirrored appliqué borders and opening-concentrated protective design
system: Palette/material: pale elm-bark cloth with indigo appliqué and light chain stitch, the pattern reading as line rather than as area
Type/composition: mirrored hook-and-spiral borders that thicken at every opening and thin across uninterrupted ground
Topology/navigation: pattern density marks thresholds, so navigation follows the ornament toward the edges rather than the centre
Controls/state: controls are openings, the active one thickens its border, and closed ones thin back to a single line
Responsive/motion: borders re-mirror along whatever edges the frame provides, and motion is a spiral extending along its own curve
concepts.spark: The pattern is heaviest exactly at the cuffs, the hem and the neck, because those are the places where something could get in.
concepts.webLeverage: svg mirrored border paths that thicken at declared openings, responsive edge re-mirroring, and spiral extension animation

concepts.form: a warp-faced carrying cloth woven in mirrored bands, the densest pattern band running the centre with plain colour fields either side, motifs counted in warp threads so the pattern exists in the setup rather than the weaving
concepts.lineage: Andean aguayo warp-faced weaving, pallay motif bands and counted-warp pattern setup
system: Palette/material: dense warp-faced wool where only the warp shows, in madder red, indigo and undyed cream, with no weft visible at all
Type/composition: a wide patterned centre band flanked by mirrored plain fields, motifs counted in threads so every curve is stepped
Topology/navigation: bands run the length so navigation moves across the cloth through bands of varying density
Controls/state: controls are bands, the active one shows its thread count, and plain fields hold their colour
Responsive/motion: bands widen or narrow in whole thread counts, and motion is a pattern building thread by thread
concepts.spark: There are no curves in it anywhere, because every shape had to be counted out in threads before a single row was woven.
concepts.webLeverage: a whole-thread-count responsive band system, stepped-curve svg motifs, and a build-by-thread animation

concepts.form: a cotton cloth drawn with a bamboo pen dipped in mordant rather than dye, the colour appearing only after the cloth is boiled so the maker works for days on marks that stay invisible until the dye bath
concepts.lineage: Deccan qalamkari mordant pen-drawing, madder boiling and multi-stage resist and mordant dyeing
system: Palette/material: madder red, iron black and indigo brought up out of the cloth by boiling, never painted on, over a myrobalan-yellowed ground
Type/composition: narrative frieze bands running the cloth's width with a dense floral border enclosing them on all four sides
Topology/navigation: work proceeds by colour stage rather than by area, so navigation moves through baths that reveal everything at once
Controls/state: controls are drawn regions, an active one holds mordant invisibly, and a bath commits every region simultaneously
Responsive/motion: frieze bands reflow in whole registers, and motion is colour rising out of the cloth during a boil
concepts.spark: You draw for three days with a bamboo pen and the cloth looks almost blank the entire time, and then it goes in the pot and everything you did appears at once.
concepts.webLeverage: a deferred-reveal state model where marks stay latent until a commit, plus a colour-rising animation and whole-register reflow

concepts.form: a knitted mitten index where each pattern names a parish, motifs recorded on squared charts beside a photographed pair, so a stranger could tell where someone came from by their hands
concepts.lineage: Estonian and Baltic mitten pattern indexing, parish-named motif systems and squared chart recording
system: Palette/material: undyed wool with madder and woad, two colours per round only, the unused colour carried behind and showing at the cuff
Type/composition: a squared chart set beside a photographed pair with the parish name ruled beneath, and a cuff band identifying the region
Topology/navigation: the index is geographic, so navigation moves across a map by way of patterns rather than place names
Controls/state: controls are charts, the active one highlights its parish, and neighbouring parishes show their related motifs
Responsive/motion: charts reflow in whole stitch counts, and motion is a pattern knitting up round by round
concepts.spark: Somebody could look at your hands and know which parish you were born in, because the pattern on the back was only ever knitted in one valley.
concepts.webLeverage: whole-stitch responsive charts linked to a geographic index, related-motif state across neighbours, and a round-by-round knit animation

concepts.form: a stencil-dyed cloth where colour is pushed through a cut paper stencil and then graded by hand inside each shape, so every flat area carries a shading nobody cut and no two repeats are identical
concepts.lineage: Ryukyuan bingata paste-resist stencil dyeing, hand-graded pigment within stencil shapes and Okinawan colour convention
system: Palette/material: brilliant Okinawan yellow, vermilion and indigo pushed through stencil openings and graded by brush inside each shape
Type/composition: a repeating stencil of birds, water and flowers where each printed shape receives individual shading after printing
Topology/navigation: the stencil repeats but the grading does not, so navigation compares supposedly identical repeats
Controls/state: controls are stencil shapes, the active one shows its grading, and ungraded shapes sit flat
Responsive/motion: the stencil retiles at any size while grading stays per-instance, and motion is colour graded into a shape after it prints
concepts.spark: The stencil is cut once and repeated across the whole bolt, and then someone shades every single printed shape by hand so that no two of them come out the same.
concepts.webLeverage: an svg stencil repeat with per-instance gradient variation, post-print grading animation, and responsive retiling

concepts.form: a cloth waxed by hand with a copper canting, its pattern chosen from a named repertoire where certain motifs were once reserved for a court and the name tells you who was permitted to wear it
concepts.lineage: Javanese batik tulis canting wax drawing, named motif repertoires and court-restricted pattern conventions
